Private and B2B, with little consumer brand awareness.

Coralogix is a SaaS observability and security platform that uses machine learning to analyse logs, metrics and traces without requiring customers to pay to index all data first. Growing consumer brand in Mexico.

KreditBee is an Indian digital lending platform offering personal loans, instant credit and credit-related products to young salaried professionals and first-time borrowers through its mobile app, alongside bank and NBFC partners. Based in Bangalore and founded in 2018. Revenue comes from interest and fees. It has raised about $642 million in total funding, with a valuation above $1 billion. Private, with IPO plans reported. Known consumer fintech app in India, with heavy digital advertising.

Lila Sciences is a Cambridge, Massachusetts company building scientific superintelligence, combining AI models with autonomous labs ("AI science factories") to run experiments in life sciences, chemistry and materials. It emerged from Flagship Pioneering in 2025. Customers would be pharma and industrial partners via research collaborations and licensing. Crunchbase shows about $551 million in total funding, the latest in January 2026. Private. Scientific B2B brand with little public awareness.

Longsys Electronics is a Shenzhen-based maker of embedded storage and memory products, including flash storage, memory modules and custom storage solutions, plus consumer memory cards under the Lexar brand, which it acquired from Micron in 2017. Customers are phone, PC, automotive and IoT manufacturers, plus global consumers via Lexar. Listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (301308). Crunchbase shows about CN¥3.7 billion in funding. Lexar is a recognised consumer brand sold worldwide.

MainFunc is the company behind Genspark, an AI agent and AI search product that carries out tasks such as research, slide and document creation and browsing for users. Based in Palo Alto, California, and founded in 2023 by former Baidu executives Eric Jing and Kay Zhu. Revenue comes from consumer and business subscriptions. Crunchbase shows about $654 million in total funding, latest June 2026. Private. Growing consumer and prosumer product in the AI space.

Manus AI develops general-purpose AI agents that autonomously complete multi-step tasks such as research, coding and report creation. Launched in 2025 by Butterfly Effect, a startup with Chinese founders that relocated to Singapore. Meta announced an acquisition of Manus in December 2025. Revenue comes from subscriptions for individuals and professionals. Crunchbase shows about $585 million in total funding, latest October 2026. Well-known in the AI community, limited mainstream consumer awareness.

MatX designs custom AI semiconductors, chips built to run large language models efficiently for training and inference. Founded in 2022 by former Google TPU engineers Reiner Pope and Mike Gunter, based in Mountain View, California. Customers are AI labs and cloud companies. Crunchbase shows about $625 million in total funding, the latest in February 2026. Private. Deep B2B brand, known in the AI hardware industry, with no consumer visibility.

ModelBest, known in Chinese as Mianbi Intelligence, is a Beijing-based AI company developing efficient large language models, notably the MiniCPM series of on-device models, spun out of Tsinghua University's NLP lab in 2022. B2B brand, known mostly in the Chinese AI community.

Momentum Financial Services Group is a Toronto, Ontario company that, according to Crunchbase, offers financial solutions and is classified under credit, finance and financial services. Crunchbase shows about $635 million in total funding. Private. B2B industrial brand, little consumer awareness.

Nearfield Instruments develops and supplies metrology and inspection equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, using atomic force microscopy based tools to measure nanoscale structures on chips, notably its QUADRA platform. Private. Deep B2B industrial brand with no consumer visibility.

(Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Private. Recognised consumer travel brand in Europe with significant online marketing.

OneStream Software provides a unified cloud platform for corporate finance, covering consolidation, planning, reporting, analytics and AI-supported close processes. Listed on Euronext Paris (SOI). Crunchbase shows $500 million in funding. Deep B2B brand with no consumer visibility.

SouthGobi Resources is a coal mining company that operates the Ovoot Tolgoi mine in Mongolia's South Gobi region and sells mostly to Chinese customers. Headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Revenue comes from sales of thermal and coking coal. Formerly majority-owned by Turquoise Hill Resources. Listed on the TSX (SGQ). Crunchbase shows about $567 million in funding. Little public brand visibility.

STARK is a Berlin-based defence technology company building unmanned systems, notably the Virtus loitering munition and one-way attack drones for armed forces, with a focus on low-cost autonomous weapons. Founded in 2024 by Florian Seibel and Jan-Hendrik Boelsen. Customers are NATO militaries, with revenue from government contracts. Backed by Sequoia and Capital Group. Crunchbase shows about $648 million in total funding. Private. Prominent in defence media, a sensitive category for sponsorship.

Synchron develops a brain-computer interface, the Stentrode, a device delivered through blood vessels that lets people with paralysis control digital devices by thought. Founded in Australia and now based in Brooklyn, New York, it runs clinical trials and has partnerships with Nvidia and Apple. Revenue would come from medical device sales, so it is currently pre-commercial. Crunchbase shows about $605 million in total funding. Private. Strong media profile in neurotechnology.

Teamshares is a platform that buys small businesses from retiring owners and converts them to employee ownership, providing the shared services, financing and software to operate them. Customers are sellers of small US businesses and the employees who become owners. It makes money from business operations, services and fees. Founded in 2019 and based in Brooklyn, New York. Crunchbase shows about $553 million in total funding, including debt. Private. Modest brand awareness.

Telpark is a Spanish mobile application that lets drivers pay for on-street regulated parking from their phone, in many Spanish cities. Crunchbase shows about 540 million in funding, which looks unusually large and is likely a data quirk. Familiar app brand locally, but little wider awareness.

Velocity Financial is a US lender that originates and services investor real estate loans, mainly for small-balance multifamily and mixed-use rental properties and short-term loans. B2B finance brand, little consumer awareness.

Watercress Financial provides home financing for contractors, according to Crunchbase, classified under finance and financial services. It is based in West Des Moines, Iowa. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

B2B brand, known mainly in Chinese AI and robotics circles.

Bath & Body Works is a specialty retailer of fragrances and personal care: body care, fine fragrance mist, hand soaps and sanitisers, 3-wick candles and home fragrance, sold under Bath & Body Works and White Barn brands. Customers are mainly women shopping in about 1,900 US and Canadian mall and street stores, plus online and international franchise stores. Revenue is around $7 billion. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, spun out of L Brands in 2021. Listed on NYSE (BBWI). Very strong consumer brand awareness in North America.

Cal-Maine Foods is the largest producer and distributor of fresh shell eggs in the United States, selling conventional, cage-free, organic and specialty eggs under brands such as Egg-Land's Best, Land O'Lakes and Farmhouse Eggs, plus egg products. Customers are grocery chains, foodservice distributors and food manufacturers. Based in Ridgeland, Mississippi, with over 50 million laying hens. Listed on Nasdaq (CALM), with revenue well above $2 billion in strong egg price years. Moderate consumer brand awareness; largely a commodity supplier.

Clearwater Paper produces private-label tissue (bath tissue, paper towels, facial tissue and napkins) for US retailers, plus paperboard for folding cartons and food service. Customers are grocery, club and discount retailers, who sell the products under their own store brands, and packaging converters. Headquartered in Spokane, Washington, it spun out from Potlatch in 2008. Revenue is about $1.4 to 1.6 billion. Listed on NYSE (CLW). B2B supplier with little consumer brand awareness.

Co-operative Group is a UK consumer co-operative owned by around 2.5 million members, running Co-op Food convenience and grocery stores, Co-op Funeralcare, Co-op Legal Services and Co-op Insurance. Based in Manchester, with about 2,300 food stores and annual revenue over 11 billion pounds. Customers are UK consumers, who earn member rewards. Mutually owned and not listed. Well-known UK consumer brand with a strong community presence.

Dana is a supplier of drivetrain and propulsion technology: axles, driveshafts, transmissions, e-motors, inverters and sealing and thermal-management products for light vehicles, commercial trucks, off-highway machinery and electric vehicles. Customers are vehicle manufacturers such as Ford, Stellantis and Cummins, with revenue of about $10 billion. Headquartered in Maumee, Ohio, with operations in about 30 countries. Listed on NYSE (DAN). In 2025 it agreed to sell its off-highway business to Allison Transmission. B2B supplier, little consumer awareness.

Ecom Agroindustrial, now ECOM Trading, is a global commodity merchant specialising in coffee, cocoa and cotton, buying from farmers in producing countries and supplying roasters, chocolate makers and textile mills. Based in Pully, Switzerland, with operations in over 40 countries and revenue in the order of $10 billion or more. Privately held, not listed. Revenue from trading, processing and logistics. B2B, with little public brand awareness.

Flutterwave is an African payments technology company that lets merchants accept card, bank transfer, mobile money and other payments, and offers payouts and cross-border infrastructure through its Flutterwave Store and APIs. Customers are businesses such as Uber and Booking.com operating in Africa. Founded in 2016 by Iyinoluwa Aboyeji and Olugbenga Agboola, with operations led from Lagos, Nigeria and listed in San Francisco. Valued around $3 billion at its 2022 round. Private. B2B brand with strong recognition in African tech.

Piaggio Group is Europe's largest scooter and motorcycle maker, owning Piaggio, Vespa, Aprilia, Moto Guzzi and Gilera, plus the Ape three-wheel commercial vehicles. Customers are consumers and businesses in Europe, India, Vietnam and the US. Headquartered in Pontedera, Tuscany, it was founded in 1884, with about 5,000 employees and revenue of roughly 1.7 billion euros. Listed on Borsa Italiana (PIA), majority controlled by Immsi. Strong consumer brands, with Aprilia in MotoGP racing.

The RealReal is an online luxury consignment marketplace that sells authenticated pre-owned designer goods: handbags, jewellery, watches, clothing and art. Consumers consign items and buyers purchase, with revenue from commissions and sales, supported by in-house authenticators and retail stores. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco, with annual revenue near $600 million. Listed on Nasdaq (REAL). Well-known US luxury resale brand with an affluent customer base.

Camping World is the largest US retailer of recreational vehicles and camping products, operating Camping World and Gander Outdoors stores, RV dealerships, service centres, plus the Good Sam club and insurance services. Customers are RV buyers and campers. Headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, with about 200 locations and revenue above $6 billion. Listed on NYSE (CWH), controlled by chairman and CEO Marcus Lemonis through ML Acquisition. Very recognisable US brand, and a known sports and NASCAR sponsor.

Canadian Tire Corporation is a Canadian retailer selling automotive parts and service, sports and leisure, home and hardware products at Canadian Tire stores, with other banners Mark's, SportChek, Party City Canada, Pro Hockey Life and Helly Hansen. It also runs Canadian Tire Bank with its store credit card. Based in Toronto, it was founded in 1922, with about 1,700 locations and revenue of about C$18 billion. Listed on the TSX (CTC). Very strong Canadian consumer brand and long-time sports sponsor, including NHL and Canadian Olympic Committee.

Catalonia Hotels & Resorts is a family-owned Spanish hotel chain founded in 1983 in Barcelona, operating around 60 or more hotels in Spain, Portugal, the Caribbean (Dominican Republic and Mexico) and Latin America. Brands include Catalonia, Zentral Hotels and Royal Hideaway. Customers are leisure and business travellers, with income from hotel rooms and services. Private and not listed. Known regionally in the Spanish and Caribbean markets, moderate consumer awareness.

COFCO International is the agricultural trading and processing arm of China's state-owned COFCO Group, buying, storing, processing and shipping grains, oilseeds, sugar, coffee, cotton and other commodities worldwide. Headquartered in Geneva (Chene-Bougeries), Switzerland, and active in the Americas, Europe, the Black Sea and Asia. Customers are food and feed manufacturers and importers. Revenue is in the tens of billions of dollars. State-owned through COFCO. B2B, with limited consumer brand awareness.

Electrify America operates the largest open DC fast-charging network for electric vehicles in the US, with over 1,000 stations and several thousand chargers on highways and in cities, and a pass-based membership. It was set up in 2016 by Volkswagen Group of America as part of its diesel emissions settlement, and is headquartered in Reston, Virginia. Siemens took a minority stake in 2021. Customers are EV drivers and automakers offering free charging. Recognised by EV owners, and has sponsored motorsport events.

ITC Hotels is the hospitality arm of ITC Limited, running luxury and premium hotels under the ITC Hotels, Welcomhotel, Storii and Fortune brands, with about 140 hotels across India. Customers are business and leisure travellers, and revenue comes from rooms, food and beverage, and events. Headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana, it was demerged from ITC Ltd and listed on the NSE and BSE in January 2025. ITC remains a major shareholder. Strong luxury brand in India with notable restaurant brands such as Bukhara.

Kakao Games is the gaming subsidiary of South Korea's Kakao Corp, publishing mobile, PC and VR games including Odin: Valhalla Rising, Ares: Rise of Guardians and Eternal Return, and running Kakao Games' US arm in Irvine, California. Customers are gamers worldwide, with in-app purchase and game revenue. It owns studios and invests in esports, and is listed on KOSDAQ (293490). Known mainly among gamers, with limited mass awareness outside Asia.

Mahindra Electric Automobile is the electric vehicle subsidiary of Mahindra & Mahindra, behind the BE 6 and XEV 9e electric SUVs on the INGLO platform, plus earlier e2o and eVerito models, and Formula E involvement via the Mahindra Racing team. Customers are Indian consumers, and revenue comes from vehicle sales. Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Investors including British International Investment committed funding in 2022. Part of a listed group (NSE: M&M). Strong brand in India with proven motorsport presence.

Lion Electric builds zero-emission medium and heavy-duty vehicles: LionD school buses and LionA and LionC commercial trucks, made in Quebec and Illinois. Customers are school districts, transit and fleet operators. Founded in 2008 in Quebec and listed on NYSE and TSX (LEV) in 2021. It entered Canadian creditor protection in December 2024, and its assets were bought by a Quebec-based investor group in 2025. Crunchbase lists a Sacramento, California location. Niche B2B brand, little mass consumer awareness.

CarTrade Tech runs online automotive marketplaces in India: CarWale and BikeWale for new vehicles, Shriram Automall for used and auction vehicles, CarTrade for used cars, plus OLX Autos' India business acquired in 2023 and AutoBiz. Customers are car buyers and sellers, dealers and banks. Revenue comes from listings, advertising and auction fees. Based in Mumbai, founded in 2009. Listed on the NSE and BSE since 2021 (CARTRADE). Recognised consumer brand in the Indian auto market.

Regent develops and manufactures all-electric seagliders, wing-in-ground-effect craft that skim over water for passenger and cargo transport, led by its Viceroy model. Founded in 2020 and based in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, it is backed by Founders Fund and others, with customer pre-orders from operators in Hawaii, the Caribbean and elsewhere. Crunchbase shows about $327 million in funding. Private. Early-stage with strong media attention, but still pre-commercial.

Air-e S.A.S. E.S.P. is the electricity distributor and retailer serving the Colombian Caribbean coast region, including Barranquilla, Atlantico, Magdalena and La Guajira, successor to Electricaribe. Customers are households and businesses, paying regulated tariffs. Created in 2020 to take over Electricaribe's Caribbean business, it has been under intervention by the utilities regulator since 2024, with operational difficulties reported. Crunchbase shows $300 million in funding. Regional utility, locally well known but with no export brand.

Carvolution is a Swiss car subscription provider offering new vehicles on all-inclusive monthly plans covering insurance, maintenance, tyres and registration, with flexible terms. Customers are private and corporate drivers in Switzerland, as well as in Germany. Based in Bannwil, Aargau, Switzerland. Crunchbase shows about CHF 266 million raised, mostly financing. Private. Known in Swiss mobility, moderate brand awareness.

Fritz Winter is a family-owned German foundry group producing cast iron components for vehicles, such as brake discs, crankshafts, engine blocks and cylinder heads, for passenger cars, trucks and construction machinery. It is based in Stadtallendorf, Hessen, with plants in Germany and abroad and several thousand employees. Customers are carmakers and tier-one suppliers. Privately held. B2B supplier, no consumer brand awareness. The row lists it as Fritz Winter training, probably an OCR variant.

TI Clean Mobility is the electric mobility subsidiary of Tube Investments of India, part of the Murugappa Group, making electric three-wheelers, tractors, and commercial EVs under brands such as Montra Electric, Cellestial E-Mobility and Montra Electric Super Auto. Customers are fleet and last-mile operators. Based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with funding commitments from the parent shown at about INR 24.9 billion. Wholly owned subsidiary of a listed group. Emerging Indian EV brand.

Winnebago Industries manufactures recreational vehicles and boats: Winnebago motorhomes and towables, Grand Design RVs, Newmar luxury coaches, plus Chris-Craft, Barletta and Southwind marine brands. Customers are US and Canadian RV and boat buyers sold through dealers, with revenue around $2.5 to 3.5 billion. Founded in 1958, with its headquarters now in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. Listed on NYSE (WGO). Iconic RV brand in North America, widely recognised by consumers.

Apollo Tyres is an Indian tyre maker producing passenger car, SUV, truck, bus, farm and two-wheeler tyres under Apollo and Vredestein brands, with plants in India, the Netherlands and Hungary. Customers are consumers, fleets and vehicle manufacturers in more than 100 countries, with revenue over INR 25,000 crore. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Gurugram. Listed on NSE and BSE (APOLLOTYRE). Known for sports sponsorship, including Indian cricket and a long-running Manchester United partnership, so well-known consumer brand.

Car Capital Technologies provides software-as-a-service tools and financing for car dealers, helping them buy, finance and manage used vehicle inventory, using technology to streamline wholesale transactions. Customers are independent and franchise dealerships. Based in Grapevine, Texas. Crunchbase shows about $280 million in total funding, much of it likely debt facilities. Private. B2B brand with limited consumer awareness.

REV Group designs and builds specialty vehicles: Spartan and Ladder Tower fire trucks, American Emergency Vehicles ambulances, Collins and ElDorado buses, Lance and Midwest Automotive, plus recreational vehicles including Holiday Rambler and Renegade, and terminal trucks like Capacity. Customers are municipalities, schools, airports and consumers, with revenue around $2.5 billion. Based in Brookfield, Wisconsin. Listed on NYSE (REVG). B2B brand with local recognition.

Kalyan Jewellers is one of India's largest jewellery retailers, selling gold, diamond and gemstone jewellery under the Kalyan and Candere brands through about 250 or more showrooms in India and the Middle East. Customers are consumers, especially for weddings and festivals, with revenue over INR 20,000 crore. Founded in 1993 and based in Thrissur, Kerala. Listed on NSE and BSE since 2021 (KALYANKJIL), backed by Warburg Pincus earlier. Very strong consumer brand in India, featuring celebrity ambassadors such as Amitabh Bachchan.

Li Krypton Technology, shown as Likrypton, is a company in Chongming, Shanghai, China, that according to Crunchbase provides product research and development services in the automotive and autonomous driving sector. It has raised about CN¥1.6 billion in total funding. Customers, products and ownership are not detailed in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Urgently is a roadside assistance and vehicle services platform that connects drivers with a network of towing, jump-start, tyre-change and other service providers through a digital platform used by automakers, insurers and fleets. Customers are car brands, insurance companies and auto clubs, who offer the service to their drivers, and revenue is per-event and subscription based. Based in Vienna, Virginia. Crunchbase shows about $219 million in funding. Private. B2B brand with low consumer awareness.

World Omni Financial is a US auto finance company providing retail and wholesale financing, leasing, and insurance products, primarily through Toyota and dealers in the southeastern US, via its Southeast Toyota Finance and JM Family operations. Based in Deerfield Beach, Florida, and part of JM Family Enterprises, the privately held automotive group. Customers are car buyers and dealers. Crunchbase shows about $220 million raised. Little consumer brand awareness outside the region.

Revel started in 2018 with shared electric mopeds in New York and later expanded to ride-hailing with electric vehicles and an EV fast-charging network, plus e-bike sharing, with revenue from rides and charging. It is headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. In 2025 it stopped its ride-hail service to focus on public charging. Customers are urban riders and EV drivers. Crunchbase shows about $274 million in funding. Private. Recognised in New York City, with limited national awareness.

Commercial Vehicle Group designs and manufactures cab-related products for commercial vehicles: seats, trim, wire harnesses, mirrors, cab structures and electrical assemblies for heavy trucks, construction and agriculture equipment, and buses. Customers are OEMs such as Daimler, Volvo and Caterpillar, with revenue around $700 to 900 million. Based in New Albany, Ohio. Listed on Nasdaq (CVGI). B2B supplier, no consumer brand awareness.

Harris Maxus is an electric car manufacturing company based in Liverpool, England, according to Crunchbase, classified under automotive and electric vehicles. Crunchbase shows about 150 million in funding. The name suggests a link to the Maxus commercial vehicle brand, but the details are not confirmed here. Product range, customers and ownership are not stated in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Intelligent Energy is a UK hydrogen fuel cell company that designs lightweight air-cooled fuel cell power systems for drones and other aircraft, automotive uses and stationary and backup power such as telecom towers. Customers include engine makers, drone makers, automakers and utilities, with revenue from products, licensing and engineering services. Based in Loughborough, England, founded in 2001. Earlier listed on AIM and later taken private. Crunchbase shows about $206 million raised. B2B brand with low consumer awareness.

KHAT is a developer and producer of electronically controlled automotive components, based in Huzhou, Zhejiang, China, according to Crunchbase. It is classified under automotive and manufacturing and has raised about CN¥1.46 billion in total funding. Customers, specific products and ownership are not stated in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Vay is a Berlin teledriving company that lets remote drivers control electric cars over mobile networks, so customers can order a car delivered to them and drive it themselves, then have it driven away remotely. It offers car rental and mobility, and has operated in Berlin, Hamburg and Las Vegas. Founded in 2018, with Crunchbase showing about $192 million in funding. Private. Known in mobility tech, limited mainstream awareness.

Bajaj Mobility AG, formerly Pierer Mobility, is the Mattighofen, Austria-based owner of the KTM, Husqvarna and GASGAS motorcycle brands, a stake in MV Agusta, plus e-bike brands, making premium off-road and street motorcycles. Bajaj Auto of India took control in 2025 after KTM's financial restructuring and the company was renamed. Customers are riders worldwide, and KTM and GASGAS race in MotoGP and Moto2/Moto3. Listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange (PKTM). Strong consumer motorsport brands.

Carbon Revolution makes lightweight carbon fibre wheels for performance and luxury cars, supplying OEMs such as Ford (Mustang GT500), Ferrari, Porsche and General Motors, with production in Geelong, Victoria. Its headquarters are listed as Melbourne, Australia, and it was founded in 2007. Listed on Nasdaq (CREV) via a 2023 SPAC merger with Twin Ridge Capital Acquisition. B2B supplier to carmakers with limited consumer awareness, though known in the performance car community. Crunchbase shows about $161 million in funding.

Cavan Auto specializes in the production of electric vehicles, according to Crunchbase, and is based in Beijing, China. It has raised about CN¥1.2 billion in total funding. Specific models, customers, ownership and sales scale are not stated in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

CarOnSale is a Berlin B2B online auction platform that lets car dealers buy used vehicles from sellers such as leasing companies, rental fleets, manufacturers and banks, digitising wholesale remarketing. Customers are professional dealers and fleet owners across Europe, with revenue from transaction fees. Founded in 2015. Crunchbase shows about $160 million in funding. Private. B2B brand with little consumer awareness.

Cowboy is a Brussels electric bike brand selling connected, app-controlled e-bikes direct to consumers online and through some partners and stores, including the Cowboy 4, Cruiser and Cruiser St models. Customers are urban commuters across Europe, with revenue from bike sales and subscriptions. Founded in 2017 by Adrien Roose and Tanguy Goretti, and acquired in 2025 after financial difficulty. Crunchbase shows about $157 million raised. Recognised European urban e-bike brand.

Turbi is a Sao Paulo digital car rental platform that lets users rent cars through an app without visiting a counter, with vehicles unlocked via phone. It offers hourly and daily rentals and has expanded across Brazilian cities. Customers are urban consumers, and revenue comes from rental fees. Crunchbase shows about $159 million in funding. Private. Recognised in Brazilian digital mobility, limited awareness outside Brazil.

ADNOC, the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, is the state-owned energy group of Abu Dhabi, covering onshore and offshore oil and gas exploration and production, refining, petrochemicals via Borouge, gas processing, and fuel retail through ADNOC Distribution. It produces around 4 million barrels of oil per day and has subsidiaries including ADNOC Drilling, ADNOC Gas and XRG. Wholly owned by the Abu Dhabi government. Several subsidiaries are listed on ADX. Very high brand profile in the Gulf.

KfW is Germany's state-owned development bank, financing small and mid-size business loans, housing and energy-efficiency programmes, student loans, export and project finance via KfW IPEX, and development aid through DEG. Headquartered in Frankfurt, owned 80 percent by the federal government and 20 percent by the states. It raises funds on capital markets with an explicit government guarantee. Total assets are around 600 billion euros or more. Well-known in Germany but public sector, with no commercial sponsorship tradition.

Deutsche Lufthansa AG is Europe's largest airline group by revenue, with Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian, Brussels Airlines, Eurowings and ITA Airways, plus Lufthansa Technik and LSG catering. It flies about 120 million passengers a year, with revenue around 37 billion euros. Headquartered in Cologne, with hubs in Frankfurt and Munich (Crunchbase lists Frankfurt). Listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (LHA). Very strong global consumer brand, with a track record of sports partnerships.

Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil and gas company, producing about 2.7 million barrels of oil equivalent per day, largely from deep-water pre-salt fields, with refining, fuel distribution, gas and growing renewables. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. The Brazilian federal government holds the voting control. Listed on B3 (PETR3/PETR4) and NYSE (PBR). Revenue is around $90 billion. Very high brand profile in Brazil, with a long history of sponsoring Brazilian sport and motorsport.

SoFi Technologies is a US digital financial services company offering student loan refinancing, personal loans, home loans, a checking and savings account, credit card, investing and crypto trading, plus the Galileo and Technisys platforms for other fintechs. It has over 12 million members and holds a national bank charter after buying Golden Pacific Bancorp in 2022. Headquartered in San Francisco, listed on Nasdaq (SOFI) via a 2021 SPAC merger. Strong consumer brand and naming-rights holder of SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.

ADQ is an Abu Dhabi sovereign investment and holding company, established in 2018, with a portfolio spanning food and agriculture (Agthia, Al Dahra), utilities (TAQA), healthcare, mobility and logistics (Etihad Rail, AD Ports Group), energy and real estate. Owned by the Abu Dhabi government, headquartered in Abu Dhabi, with assets of well over $200 billion. Investor and owner of many sponsor-capable companies. Low direct consumer visibility, though its holdings are better known.

Alpha Generation is a US independent power producer based in Houston, Texas, that owns and operates natural gas-fired power plants. It sells power into wholesale markets. Crunchbase shows about $5.95 billion in funding, probably debt financing. Private. B2B energy company with little public brand awareness.

Bank of America is one of the largest US banks, offering consumer banking, credit and debit cards, mortgages, small business banking, wealth management through Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank, and corporate and investment banking through BofA Securities. It serves tens of millions of customers, with about 3,700 branches and total assets of over $3 trillion. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. Listed on NYSE (BAC). Very strong consumer brand, a long-time naming-rights holder and sponsor of sports, golf, soccer and the Chicago Marathon.

Bank of Shanghai is a mid-size Chinese commercial bank offering corporate and retail banking, wealth management, credit cards, and trade and financial markets services, headquartered in Shanghai (Crunchbase shows a Hong Kong address). Customers are Chinese consumers and businesses, especially in the Yangtze River Delta, with assets over CNY 3 trillion. Founded in 1995 and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (601229). Local brand in China.

Banque Saudi Fransi (BSF) is a Saudi Arabian bank offering retail, corporate, treasury and investment banking, Islamic products, and brokerage through Alfransi Capital. Headquartered in Riyadh, it was established in 1977 as a joint venture, and French bank Credit Agricole has been a major shareholder. Customers are Saudi consumers and businesses, with assets of roughly 300 billion riyals. Listed on Tadawul (1050). Well-known banking brand in Saudi Arabia.

Bapco Energies is the Bahrain state-owned oil and gas holding company, the successor to Bapco, running the Sitra refinery, fuel distribution and retail through Bapco Energies Retail stations, Bahrain Petroleum, Tatweer Petroleum and Bapco Gas. It operates under the Bahrain government, with the Sitra refinery expansion project financed by about $4 billion of loans. It is a major national employer. Well-known in Bahrain.

Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) is a large Indian state-controlled oil refiner and marketer, with refineries at Mumbai, Kochi and Bina and a retail network of over 20,000 petrol stations, plus LPG (Bharatgas), lubricants, aviation fuel and a growing gas and renewables business. Headquartered in Mumbai, with revenue over $50 billion. The Government of India holds a majority stake. Listed on NSE and BSE (BPCL). Very strong consumer brand in India, with sports sponsorship including cricket.

BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, with about $11 trillion in assets under management, offering iShares ETFs, active funds, the Aladdin risk and portfolio platform, and private markets including GIP and Preqin acquisitions. Customers are institutions, pension funds, governments and retail investors. Headquartered in New York, founded in 1988, and listed on NYSE (BLK). Strong finance brand, known to investors; little direct consumer retail brand, though iShares is well known.

Capital Power is a North American power producer based in Edmonton, Alberta, owning natural gas, wind, solar, coal-to-gas and battery assets in Canada and the US with around 8 gigawatts of capacity, selling power into markets and under contracts. Customers are utilities, industrial buyers and wholesale markets. Spun out of EPCOR in 2009 and listed on the TSX (CPX). Funding shown reflects equity and debt raised. B2B energy producer, low consumer awareness beyond Alberta.

Castleton Commodities International (CCI) is a Stamford, Connecticut commodities merchant trading and producing physical oil, gas, power and refined products, and owning upstream oil and gas assets through Castleton Resources and storage. Launched in 2011 with Carlyle backing. Customers are producers, utilities and industrial buyers. Private. B2B trader with little public brand awareness.

China Everbright Bank is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank offering corporate and retail banking, credit cards, wealth management and financial markets services across China. Headquartered in Beijing, founded in 1992, with assets over CNY 6 trillion. Customers are Chinese consumers and businesses. State-linked shareholders include China Everbright Group and Central Huijin. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (601818) and Hong Kong (6818). Recognised Chinese bank brand.

China Minsheng Banking Corp is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank founded in 1996 as the first bank mostly owned by private enterprises, offering corporate banking, retail banking, small business loans, credit cards and wealth management. Headquartered in Beijing, with assets over CNY 7 trillion. Customers are Chinese consumers and businesses. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (600016) and Hong Kong (1988). Recognised bank brand in China.

Crane Company is a Stamford, Connecticut industrial technology company that makes engineered products for aerospace and electronics (Crane Aerospace & Electronics) and process flow technologies, including valves, pumps and payment and merchandising technologies, after a 2023 separation of Crane NXT. Customers are aircraft makers, defence, chemical, oil and gas and energy plants. Revenue is around $2 billion. Listed on NYSE (CR). B2B, low consumer brand awareness.

Darling Ingredients is a global converter of food waste and animal by-products into ingredients: fats, proteins, collagen and gelatin (Rousselot, Gelnex), pet food ingredients, and renewable fuels such as renewable diesel through the Diamond Green Diesel joint venture with Valero. Customers are food, feed, pharma, pet food and fuel markets. Headquartered in Irving, Texas, with over 260 plants on five continents and revenue around $6 billion. Listed on NYSE (DAR). B2B, little consumer awareness.

Duke Energy Florida is the regulated electric utility subsidiary of Duke Energy serving about 2 million customers across central and north Florida, including the St. Petersburg area, generating power from natural gas, nuclear, solar and other sources and delivering it to homes and businesses. Revenue comes from regulated rates. Crunchbase lists the Duke Energy parent location in Charlotte, North Carolina. Parent Duke Energy is listed on NYSE (DUK). Utility brand with local consumer familiarity, no consumer choice.

Embraer is a Brazilian aerospace manufacturer making E-Jets and E2 regional airliners, Phenom and Praetor business jets, the C-390 Millennium military transport and defence and security systems, plus services and eVTOL development through Eve. Headquartered in Sao Jose dos Campos, Brazil (the Saudi Arabia country tag looks wrong). Customers are airlines, governments and private jet owners, with revenue around $6 billion or more. Listed on B3 (EMBR3) and NYSE (ERJ). Well-known in aviation, with limited consumer visibility.

Enilive is the Eni subsidiary created in 2023 that combines Eni's retail fuel stations, biorefining, biofuels such as HVO, electric vehicle charging through Plenitude's charging business, car sharing (Enjoy), and lubricants. It operates thousands of stations in Italy and across Europe under the Eni brand. Headquartered in Rome, with KKR buying a 25 percent stake in 2024. Customers are drivers and businesses. Strong consumer brand in Italy and Europe, with a history in motorsport and sport sponsorship.

Enterprise Products Partners is one of the largest US midstream energy companies, running natural gas, NGL, crude oil, petrochemical and refined products pipelines, storage, export terminals and processing plants. Customers are producers, refiners, petrochemical makers and export buyers, paid through fee-based services. Headquartered in Houston, Texas. Structured as a master limited partnership listed on NYSE (EPD), with market value above $60 billion. B2B infrastructure, with little consumer brand awareness.

F&G Annuities & Life is a US life insurer selling fixed indexed annuities, indexed universal life and pension risk transfer, distributed through independent agents, banks and broker-dealers. Based in Des Moines, Iowa, with over $60 billion of assets under management. It was owned by Fidelity National Financial, which listed it on NYSE (FG) in 2022. Customers are retirement savers. Crunchbase shows about $3.27 billion in funding. Low consumer brand awareness; sold mostly via intermediaries.

Gree Electric Appliances is a major Chinese maker of household and commercial air conditioners, the world's largest by volume, along with small appliances, refrigerators and industrial equipment, sold under Gree, Tosot and Kinghome. Based in Zhuhai (Crunchbase lists Hefei, Anhui, where it has a factory), with global sales in over 100 countries and revenue above CNY 200 billion. Listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (000651). Strong consumer brand in China.

Hess Midstream is a Houston-based midstream company that gathers, processes and compresses natural gas, handles crude oil and water services, and operates terminals mainly for Hess Corporation's Bakken production in North Dakota. Revenue is fee-based under long-term contracts with Hess, now part of Chevron after the 2025 acquisition. Structured as an MLP and later converted to a C-corp, listed on NYSE (HESM). B2B infrastructure, little public brand awareness.

Howden Group Holdings is a London-headquartered international insurance and reinsurance broking group, placing commercial, specialty, reinsurance and personal insurance for corporate and individual clients, and also running underwriting and managing general agent businesses. Founded in 2006 by David Howden, it has grown through acquisitions to operate in over 100 countries with tens of thousands of staff. Revenue is in the billions of dollars. Privately owned by management and investors including General Atlantic. B2B brand with moderate awareness in insurance and increasing corporate sponsorship visibility.

HUB International is one of the largest insurance brokerages in North America, selling property and casualty, employee benefits, personal insurance, risk services and wealth management through hundreds of offices across the US and Canada. Customers are businesses and individuals, with revenue from commissions and fees of about $4 billion or more. Headquartered in Chicago, majority owned by private equity firm Hellman & Friedman, with other minority investors. Private. B2B and local brand, little national consumer awareness.

iQiyi is one of China's largest online video platforms, streaming original series, films, variety shows, anime and licensed content, with revenue from membership subscriptions, advertising, content licensing and other services. Customers are Chinese viewers and advertisers, with international service in Southeast Asia and elsewhere. Headquartered in Beijing, founded in 2010, controlled by search giant Baidu. Listed on Nasdaq (IQ). Very strong consumer brand in China, with a wide base of paying members.

JD Digits, previously JD Finance, is the digital technology and financial services arm that spun out of JD.com, providing digital finance, cloud, AI and risk technology services to banks, financial institutions, governments and enterprises, plus consumer finance products. Headquartered in Beijing. Founded in 2013, with major backing from JD.com and investors including state-linked funds. Crunchbase shows about CN¥34 billion in total funding. Private and not listed. Known in China through JD's consumer credit products such as JD Baitiao, but largely B2B.

Kinetik is a Permian Basin midstream company that gathers, compresses, processes and transports natural gas, crude oil and produced water, with pipelines and processing plants in Texas and New Mexico. Customers are oil and gas producers, with revenue from fee-based contracts. Headquartered in Midland, Texas, formed in 2022 through the combination of Altus Midstream and BCP Raptor. Listed on NYSE (KNTK). B2B, little consumer brand awareness.

Nabors Industries is one of the world's largest land drilling contractors, providing rigs, drilling services, drilling automation software and tools such as Canrig, plus offshore platform drilling, serving oil and gas producers in the US, Middle East, Latin America and Asia. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with a Bermuda legal domicile, and revenue of about $3 billion. Acquired Parker Wellbore in 2024. Listed on NYSE (NBR). B2B, low consumer visibility.

Napster, formerly Infinite Reality, is a US company focused on immersive 3D and AI-enabled websites, digital media and commerce. In 2025 Infinite Reality acquired the Napster music brand, and the combined company now operates as Napster. Crunchbase shows about $3.35 billion in total funding, a figure to treat with caution. Customers are brands, creators and consumers. Crunchbase lists Norwalk, Connecticut. Napster is a recognised consumer name from its music streaming history.

Northrop Grumman is a major US aerospace and defence contractor, building the B-21 Raider bomber, Sentinel ICBM, space systems, unmanned aircraft such as Global Hawk, missiles, cyber and mission systems. Customers are mainly the US Department of Defense and allied governments, with annual sales of about $40 billion and about 95,000 employees. Headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia. Listed on NYSE (NOC). Defence brand well known in government and aerospace, with limited consumer relevance and sensitive for sponsorship.

Octopus Energy is a UK energy retailer supplying electricity and gas to millions of households, known for smart tariffs, heat pumps and EV charging, and it also licenses the Kraken utility software platform to other energy suppliers worldwide. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, with operations in Europe, the US, Australia, Japan and elsewhere. Part of Octopus Group, with Kraken spun out as a separately funded business. Private. Strong consumer brand in the UK.

OneMain Financial is a leading US consumer lender, offering personal loans to nonprime customers through about 1,300 branches and online, along with credit cards and optional insurance products. Customers are middle-income Americans who may have limited access to bank credit, with revenue from interest and fees, and a loan book of about $24 billion. Crunchbase lists Baltimore, Maryland. Listed on NYSE (OMF). Established consumer finance brand in the US.

Pembina Pipeline is a Calgary-based Canadian energy infrastructure company that transports and processes crude oil and natural gas liquids, runs gas gathering and processing plants and export terminals, and has a stake in Cedar LNG. Customers are oil and gas producers and shippers on fee-based contracts, with revenue of about C$8 billion. Founded in 1954. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (PBA). B2B energy company with local recognition in Alberta.

Permian Resources is a US independent oil and gas producer focused on the Delaware Basin in the Permian, producing about 350,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Customers are refiners and midstream buyers, with revenue from oil and gas sales. Headquartered in Midland, Texas, formed in 2022 through the merger of Centennial Resource Development and Colgate Energy. Listed on NYSE (PR). B2B energy producer, little consumer brand awareness.

Plains All American Pipeline is a Houston-based midstream company that transports, stores and markets crude oil and natural gas liquids, with thousands of miles of pipelines, storage terminals and rail and truck assets, mostly in the Permian Basin and across North America. Customers are producers and refiners, with revenue largely fee-based plus marketing. Structured as a master limited partnership, with units listed on Nasdaq (PAA). B2B, little consumer awareness.

Plug Power is a hydrogen fuel cell company providing green hydrogen production, electrolyzers, liquid hydrogen and fuel cell systems for forklifts and material handling, with customers including Amazon and Walmart. Headquartered in Latham, New York, founded in 1997. It has reported heavy losses and raised substantial capital. Listed on Nasdaq (PLUG). B2B brand, known to investors and in clean energy, with limited consumer awareness.

Santos is an Australian oil and gas company, founded in 1954 and headquartered in Adelaide, producing natural gas and LNG from the Cooper Basin, Queensland (GLNG), Papua New Guinea (PNG LNG), Darwin LNG and Bayu-Undan, with the Barossa project in development. Customers are utilities, LNG buyers in Asia and domestic gas users, with annual production of roughly 90 million barrels of oil equivalent. Listed on the ASX (STO). Known in Australia, with sports and community sponsorship.

SEGRO is a UK real estate investment trust that owns, manages and develops modern warehouses and light industrial property, including urban warehousing and large distribution centres, in the UK and continental Europe. Customers are logistics, retail and e-commerce tenants, with revenue from rent. Headquartered in London, with a portfolio valued around 20 billion pounds. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (SGRO). B2B property company, with little consumer awareness.

Siemens Energy is a Munich-based energy technology group making gas and steam turbines, grid technologies, transformers, wind turbines through Siemens Gamesa, and electrolyzers and compressors. Customers are utilities, grid operators and industrial companies, with revenue about 35 to 40 billion euros and some 90,000 employees. Spun out of Siemens in 2020 and listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (ENR). B2B brand, well known in industry and with the Siemens name carrying wider recognition.

Tabreed, the National Central Cooling Company, is a district cooling provider that produces and delivers chilled water to buildings in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar and India, serving commercial, residential and public developments, with a sizeable capacity of over 1 million refrigeration tons. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, with Mubadala and French utility Engie among its shareholders. Revenue comes from long-term capacity and consumption charges. Listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (TABREED). B2B, regional recognition.

Take-Two Interactive is a video game publisher and developer behind the Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption) and 2K labels (NBA 2K, WWE 2K, Borderlands, Civilization), plus Zynga mobile games acquired in 2022. Customers are gamers worldwide, with revenue of about $5.5 billion to $6 billion from game sales, in-game purchases and subscriptions. Headquartered in New York. Listed on Nasdaq (TTWO). Games are global consumer brands, with GTA among the best-selling franchises.

Tata Power is one of India's largest integrated power companies, generating electricity from thermal, hydro, solar and wind, operating distribution utilities in Mumbai, Delhi and Odisha, and building rooftop solar, EV charging and solar manufacturing through Tata Power Solar. Customers are households, businesses and state utilities, with revenue above INR 60,000 crore. Part of the Tata Group, founded in 1919 and headquartered in Mumbai. Listed on the NSE and BSE (TATAPOWER). Strong consumer-facing brand in India.

Archion is a Japanese commercial vehicle holding company formed to combine truck makers Hino Motors and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck and Bus, bringing together Toyota and Daimler Truck interests in the Japanese and Asian truck market. Axian Telecom is a pan-African and Indian Ocean telecoms and financial technology group, running mobile operators and mobile money, fibre and data centres under brands such as Telma in Madagascar and Yas in several countries, with Axian Fintech offering Mixx by Yas. CACI International is a US information technology and expertise services provider to government, delivering intelligence, cyber, communications, enterprise IT and mission support for the US Department of Defense and intelligence agencies, with revenue of about $8 billion and some 25,000 employees. China State Railway Group, formerly China Railway Corporation, is the state-owned operator of China's national rail network, running passenger and freight services including the high-speed network of more than 40,000 kilometres and the China Railway brand. Gulf Marine Services operates a fleet of self-propelled, self-elevating support vessels (SESVs), jack-up barges used for offshore oil, gas and wind construction and maintenance work in the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Petco is a US pet specialty retailer selling pet food, supplies and live animals, and providing grooming, training and veterinary services through Vetco clinics, with about 1,500 stores and an online business. Telstra is Australia's largest telecommunications company, providing mobile, fixed broadband, data, TV, enterprise and network services, and owning the largest mobile network in the country. Tiendas 3B is a Mexican retail chain that, according to Crunchbase, offers household cleaning, personal hygiene, food and beverage and other everyday products. Dorjilung Hydro Power is a special purpose vehicle formed to build and run the Dorjilung hydroelectric project of roughly 1,125 megawatts in eastern Bhutan, near Mongar. Western Union is a global money transfer company, enabling consumers to send money across more than 200 countries and territories through agents, retail locations, online and its app, plus business payments.
