Solid Power develops solid-state battery materials and cells for electric vehicles, including sulfide-based solid electrolytes, and partners with BMW, Ford and SK On for production lines and pilot cells. Headquartered in Louisville, Colorado, and founded in 2011. Revenue comes mainly from joint development agreements and electrolyte sales. Listed on Nasdaq (SLDP) after a 2021 SPAC merger with Decarbonization Plus Acquisition III. B2B technology supplier with little consumer awareness.

Thought Machine is a London-based cloud-native core banking software company, selling its Vault Core platform to banks such as JPMorgan Chase, Lloyds, Standard Chartered and SEB. Founded in 2014 by former Google engineer Paul Taylor. Revenue comes from software licences and subscriptions. Has raised about $665 million in total funding and was valued around $2.7 billion in 2022. Private. B2B brand known in banking technology, with no consumer awareness.

U.S. Physical Therapy is the operator of one of the largest US networks of outpatient physical and occupational therapy clinics, with about 700 or more clinics, plus an industrial injury prevention business. Revenue comes from patient visits billed to insurers and Medicare, at around $700 million annually. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, founded in 1990. Listed on NYSE (USPH). Healthcare services brand, local rather than national consumer recognition.

International Money Express (Intermex) is a Miami-based remittance company that sends money from the US and Europe to Latin America and the Caribbean, mainly Mexico and Guatemala, through agent locations and a digital app. Customers are immigrant workers and their families, with revenue of about $650 million from fees and currency spreads. Listed on Nasdaq (IMXI). Western Union agreed in 2025 to acquire it. Well known among its target community.

Lighthouse, formerly OTA Insight, is a London-based commercial platform for the travel and hospitality industry, giving hotels market and rate intelligence, business intelligence and distribution tools, serving thousands of hotels in many countries. Revenue comes from software subscriptions. Crunchbase shows about $470 million in funding. Private. B2B brand, known to hoteliers and revenue managers, with no consumer awareness.

PayZen is a San Francisco healthcare fintech startup working to reduce medical debt and patient financial burden, offering patient-friendly financing and payment plans that use AI-based affordability decisions for health systems and providers. Customers are hospitals and clinics rather than consumers directly. Crunchbase shows about $472 million in funding, likely including a large share of loan capital. Private. B2B brand with little consumer awareness.

PPRO is a London-based fintech providing payments infrastructure that lets global merchants and payment companies accept local payment methods, including e-wallets and bank transfers, in more than 100 markets via a single integration. Customers are payment service providers and large online merchants, with revenue from processing fees. Crunchbase shows about $463 million in funding. Private, backed by Citi and other investors. B2B brand, little consumer awareness.

Cleerly is a Denver-based digital health company using AI to analyse coronary CT angiograms for atherosclerosis plaque, giving cardiologists detailed reports on heart disease risk. Customers are hospitals, imaging centres and heart clinics, with revenue from per-scan analysis, partly reimbursed by US insurers. Founded in 2017 by cardiologist James Min. Has raised about $386 million in total funding. Private. Healthcare technology brand with very limited consumer awareness.

JobNimbus is a Lehi, Utah software company that offers CRM, project management and production tools for contractors, especially roofing and exterior trades, as a subscription mobile and web app. Customers are small and mid-size contractors across the US. Crunchbase shows about $383 million in total funding. Private. B2B niche brand, known mainly within the contracting trades.

Ledger Investing is a New York-based online marketplace for insurance-linked securities, matching insurers that want to raise capital against loss reserves with institutional investors. Customers are insurance companies and investors, with revenue from transaction and platform fees. Crunchbase shows about $441 million in funding, which may include capital placed through its platform. Private. Specialist B2B brand with no consumer visibility, and not related to the Paris-based Ledger.

Nayax is an Israeli fintech providing cashless payment, telemetry and management solutions for unattended retail such as vending machines, kiosks, car washes, laundromats and EV chargers, with card readers and a software platform deployed on millions of devices worldwide. Headquartered in Herzliya, with revenue of about $400 million. Listed on Nasdaq (NYAX) and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. B2B brand, though its readers are visible in public spaces.

OneFootball is a Berlin-based football media company with a free app serving scores, news, video and live match streaming for millions of fans, particularly in Europe, Brazil and Mexico. Founded in 2008. Revenue comes from advertising, sponsorship, and e-commerce and streaming rights. Crunchbase shows about $442 million in funding. Private. Strong consumer sports media brand with direct access to football fans.

Perfios is an Indian B2B fintech software company providing data aggregation, bank statement analysis, income verification, onboarding and credit decisioning tools to banks, lenders and fintechs in India and abroad, after acquiring Karza Technologies. Headquartered in Bangalore. Founded in 2008, with investors including Warburg Pincus and Kedaara Capital, and valued over $1 billion. Crunchbase shows about $441 million in funding. Private. B2B brand with little consumer awareness.

Shiprocket is an Indian e-commerce enablement platform that aggregates courier partners, shipping, returns and fulfilment, and provides checkout, marketing and logistics tools for online sellers and D2C brands. Based in New Delhi, founded in 2012, serving hundreds of thousands of sellers. Revenue comes from shipping margins and software fees. Has raised about $424 million and was valued at over $1 billion. Private, with IPO plans reported. B2B brand known among Indian online sellers.

Backflip is an Austin, Texas proptech fintech offering software and financing for real estate investors who buy and renovate properties, with tools for deal analysis, renovation planning and lending. Customers are residential investors and flippers across the US. Crunchbase shows about $344 million in funding, including debt capital. Private. B2B niche brand with little general consumer awareness.

CMC Markets is a London-based online trading company offering contracts for difference, spread betting and forex through its Next Generation platform, plus stockbroking, and providing white-label technology to banks and brokers. Customers are retail and institutional traders in the UK, Europe, Australia and Asia. Founded in 1989. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (CMCX). Known among traders, and a past sponsor of sports and events.

ixigo (Le Travenues Technology) is an Indian online travel platform and app for train, flight, bus and hotel bookings, particularly strong in rail ticketing with live train status and tools, aimed at mass-market travellers. Based in Gurugram, founded in 2007. Revenue comes from commissions and advertising. Listed on the NSE and BSE since its 2024 IPO. Crunchbase shows about $339 million in funding. Widely used consumer app in India.

Notion is an all-in-one workspace app combining notes, documents, wikis, project management, databases and AI assistants, used by individuals, teams and large companies. Revenue comes from per-user subscriptions, with over 100 million users and a reported valuation of around $10 billion. Founded in 2013, with headquarters in San Francisco. Crunchbase shows about $343 million in total funding. Private. Very recognisable among knowledge workers and students, with heavy creator marketing.

re:cap is a Berlin-based capital operating system that combines debt and equity financing tools for startups and small businesses, including revenue-based financing, with a platform for managing funding. Customers are startups and scaleups, mainly in Europe. Crunchbase shows about $377 million in funding, largely debt facilities. Private. B2B fintech brand, known in the startup funding scene, with little consumer awareness.

Thunes is a Singapore-based cross-border payments network connecting banks, mobile money wallets and payment providers across more than 130 countries, letting customers send money to wallets, accounts and cards in real time. Customers are fintechs, remittance firms and global platforms, with revenue from transaction fees. Founded in 2016. Crunchbase shows about $352 million in funding. Private. B2B infrastructure brand, no consumer awareness.

Fibe, formerly EarlySalary, is a Pune-based Indian consumer lending app offering salary advances, personal loans and credit lines to young salaried professionals, using alternative data for credit decisions. Founded in 2015. Revenue comes from interest and fees on loans, with funding from investors such as TPG, Eight Roads and Ribbit. Crunchbase shows about $294 million raised. Private. Known fintech app in India, with consumer advertising.

ShiftMed is a healthcare staffing app and platform that connects nurses and care workers with hospitals, nursing homes and other facilities for on-demand and flexible shifts, with scheduling and credentialing tools. Based in McLean, Virginia. Revenue comes from staffing fees charged to facilities. Crunchbase shows about $315 million in funding. Private. Workforce brand known to healthcare staff and employers, with no mass consumer awareness.

Argo Blockchain is a London-headquartered Bitcoin mining company with its Helios facility in Texas and earlier sites in Canada, using mined output sold to the market, and has been through financial restructuring in 2025. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (ARB) and previously on Nasdaq (ARBK). Revenue depends on Bitcoin prices and hash rate. Crunchbase shows about $260 million in funding. Investor-focused brand with limited consumer awareness.

Flow Traders is an Amsterdam-based technology-driven liquidity provider and market maker, trading exchange-traded products (ETFs and ETPs), equities, fixed income and crypto assets on global venues. Customers are exchanges, issuers and institutions, with revenue from trading gains and spreads of several hundred million euros. Founded in 2004. Listed on Euronext Amsterdam (FLOW). B2B, with low retail awareness.

Flowdesk is a Paris-based digital asset trading company providing market making, liquidity, over-the-counter trading and treasury services to crypto projects, exchanges and institutions, using algorithmic strategies. Founded in 2020. Customers are token issuers and exchanges. Crunchbase shows about $282 million in funding, which likely includes capital for trading. Private. B2B brand known in the crypto industry, with no consumer awareness.

Nebeus is a Barcelona-based fintech app bridging digital assets and traditional finance, allowing customers to buy, hold and borrow against crypto and make payments, with a focus on European users. Revenue comes from lending interest, trading and service fees. Crunchbase shows about $283 million in funding, a figure that looks high for a company of its size. Private. Niche crypto consumer brand with limited awareness.

Phantom is a crypto wallet, best known for Solana, now also supporting Ethereum, Bitcoin, Base and Polygon, letting users buy, swap, stake and hold tokens and NFTs through a browser extension and mobile app. Founded in 2021 and based in San Francisco. Revenue comes from swap fees and other services. Has raised about $268 million and was valued around $3 billion in 2025. Private. Large user base with strong awareness in the crypto community.

Rasan is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia fintech company, according to Crunchbase, specializing in insurance-related services and classified under Artificial Intelligence. Crunchbase shows about $269 million in total funding. The name may also refer to a Saudi information technology firm, so the match is uncertain. Products, customers and ownership are not confirmed here. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Zero Hash (zerohash) provides crypto, stablecoin and tokenisation infrastructure through APIs, allowing fintechs, banks and brokerages to offer trading, custody and settlement of digital assets without building their own systems. Founded in 2017 and based in Chicago. Customers include Interactive Brokers and neobanks, and revenue comes from transaction fees. Has raised about $282 million and was valued around $1 billion in 2025. Private. B2B brand, known in fintech and crypto.

Erco Energia is a Medellin, Colombia company that designs and builds renewable energy and electric mobility solutions, including solar installations and EV charging stations, for businesses, municipalities and electricity users in Colombia and Latin America. Revenue comes from project work, equipment and services. Crunchbase shows about $166 million in total funding. Private. Regional B2B brand, with little consumer awareness.

AmeriTrust Financial Technologies is a Burlington, Ontario, Canada company classified by Crunchbase under automotive and information technology, and the row is marked as a listed company. Crunchbase shows about $103 million in total funding. No business description is available in the input, so its products, customers and exchange listing are not confirmed here. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

CarTrade Tech runs online automotive marketplaces in India: CarWale and BikeWale for new vehicles, CarTrade for used cars, Shriram Automall for used and auction vehicles,. Customers are car buyers and sellers, dealers, banks and OEMs, with revenue from listings, advertising and auctions. Based in Navi Mumbai (Vashi), founded in 2009. Listed on the NSE and BSE since 2021 (CARTRADE). Recognised consumer brand in Indian auto.

Marcopolo is a Brazilian bus body manufacturer, one of the largest in the world, producing intercity, urban, school and BRT buses and coaches, with plants in Brazil, Argentina, China, India, South Africa, Mexico and Australia. Headquartered in Caxias do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, and founded in 1949. Customers are bus operators and chassis makers, exporting to over 100 countries. Listed on B3 (POMO4). B2B industrial brand, known across Latin America.

SPR Auto Technologies Limited is a New Delhi, India company classified by Crunchbase under automotive and manufacturing, and the row is marked as a listed company. Funding is shown as about 9.99 billion in an unspecified currency, which is likely a data error. No business description is available in the input, so its products, customers and exchange listing are not confirmed here. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Tata Motors is India's largest automaker by revenue and part of the Tata Group, making passenger cars and SUVs (Nexon, Punch, Harrier, Safari), electric vehicles, and commercial trucks and buses, and owning Jaguar Land Rover. In October 2025 it was demerged into a passenger vehicle business (including JLR) and a commercial vehicle business. Listed on the NSE and BSE. Crunchbase shows Pune as the location. Very strong consumer brand in India and globally through JLR.

Tupy is a Brazilian foundry group that makes cast iron engine blocks, cylinder heads and structural components for trucks, cars, agricultural and construction equipment, and hydraulic parts, with plants in Brazil and Mexico, and the Teksid iron foundry business acquired in 2019. Headquartered in Joinville, Santa Catarina, founded in 1938. Customers are global engine and vehicle makers. Listed on B3 (TUPY3). B2B supplier with little consumer awareness.

Aurrigo International develops autonomous vehicles and software for airports, including the Auto-DollyST baggage tug and the Auto-Shuttle, working with airports and airlines. Headquartered in Coventry, England. Customers include airport operators and ground handlers. Listed on AIM (AURR) on the London Stock Exchange. B2B technology brand, small cap, with little consumer awareness.

AYRO is a Round Rock, Texas maker of low-speed electric utility vehicles for campuses, municipalities and commercial fleets, including the AYRO Vanish. Customers are universities, municipalities and fleets, with small revenue. Listed on Nasdaq (AYRO). Small-cap EV company with minimal consumer brand awareness.

Cango Inc. started as a Chinese automotive financing and used car services platform (Cango auto transaction network) and, from 2025, expanded into Bitcoin mining after selling its auto finance business. Based in China. Listed on NYSE (CANG), revenue historically from used car and financing services. Crunchbase shows about $86 million in funding. Little consumer awareness outside China.

MotorK is a Milan-based software-as-a-service company providing digital marketing and sales tools for car dealers and manufacturers, including lead management, websites, advertising and customer data across European markets. Customers are dealer groups and carmakers. It went public on Euronext Amsterdam in 2021 (MTRK). Crunchbase shows about $76 million in funding. B2B brand, known in the automotive retail sector, with no consumer awareness.

TVS Holdings is a holding company of the TVS Group of Chennai, India, with interests in automotive components, motorcycles through TVS Motor Company, distribution and finance. Customers range from consumers to vehicle makers. Listed on the NSE and BSE. The Crunchbase funding figure is not meaningful. Part of one of India's best-known industrial families, with the TVS brand widely known.

U Power is a Shanghai-based provider of battery swapping and charging solutions for electric vehicles, developing swap stations and a standardised battery pack system for car makers and operators. Customers are EV makers, ride-hailing fleets and drivers. Listed on Nasdaq (UCAR). Crunchbase shows about $65 million in funding. Small-cap B2B EV infrastructure brand, with limited consumer awareness.

Autozi.com, or Autozi Internet Technology, is a Beijing-based online B2B marketplace and platform for automotive aftermarket parts and services, connecting suppliers, repair shops and distributors across China. Revenue comes from product sales and platform services. Listed on Nasdaq (AZI) since 2023. Crunchbase shows about $56 million in funding. B2B brand with no consumer visibility outside China.

GreenPower Motor Company builds all-electric buses and trucks, including school buses (BEAST), transit buses and cargo vans, from its Riverside, California facility, and was founded in Vancouver, Canada. Customers are school districts, transit agencies and fleet operators, often supported by public funding. Listed on Nasdaq (GP) and earlier TSXV. Crunchbase shows about $46 million in funding. Small-cap B2B EV maker with little consumer awareness.

Grupo Vasconia is a Mexican manufacturer of aluminium cookware, kitchenware and household products, selling under brands such as Vasconia, Magefesa and Ekco in Mexico and the US. Based in the Mexico City area (Crunchbase lists Cuautitlan). Customers are retailers and consumers. Listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange (VASCONI). Crunchbase categorises it under automotive, which looks inaccurate. Recognised household brand in Mexico.

Hainan Drinda Automotive Trim Systems is a Haikou, Hainan, China company classified by Crunchbase under automotive and electronics, and the row is marked as a listed company. Funding is shown as HK$397.7 million. No business description is available in the input, so its products, customers and exchange listing are not confirmed here. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

NowVertical Group is a Toronto-based data and analytics software and services company that helps organisations, including automotive businesses, use data and AI through a group of acquired firms. Customers are enterprises. Listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (NOW). Crunchbase shows about $55 million in funding. B2B brand, small cap, with no consumer awareness.

TVS Motor Company is a major Indian two-wheeler and three-wheeler maker, producing the Apache, Jupiter, Raider, iQube electric scooter and Ntorq brands, and owning Norton Motorcycles and the Swiss E-Mobility Group. Headquartered in Chennai (Crunchbase lists the Hosur plant). Sells in over 80 countries with annual revenue of around INR 35,000 crore. Part of the TVS Group. Listed on the NSE and BSE. Strong consumer brand, active in motorsport with TVS Racing.

Jiangsu Lopal Tech is a Nanjing, Jiangsu, China company classified by Crunchbase under automotive and manufacturing, and the row is marked as a listed company. Funding is shown as HK$196 million, suggesting a listing on the Hong Kong exchange. No business description is available in the input, so its products and customers are not confirmed here. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Stardust Power is a Greenwich, Connecticut-based developer of battery-grade lithium processing, planning a lithium refinery in Oklahoma to produce lithium carbonate and hydroxide for electric vehicle batteries. Customers would be battery and automotive makers. Listed on Nasdaq (SDST) through a SPAC merger with Global Partner Acquisition Corp II. Crunchbase shows about $36 million in funding. Pre-revenue small cap with no consumer awareness.

Avolon is a Dublin-based aircraft leasing company with a portfolio of over 1,000 owned, managed and on-order aircraft leased to airlines across the world, and one of the largest lessors. Founded in 2010 by former RBS aviation executives, it is owned by Bohai Leasing and ORIX, and not listed. Revenue comes from lease rentals, and its financing includes large debt facilities. B2B brand known in aviation finance, with no consumer awareness.

Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) is South Korea's state-controlled electric utility, which owns the national transmission and distribution network and a large share of generation through subsidiaries, selling electricity to households and industry, with nuclear and thermal plants and overseas projects including the UAE Barakah plant. Headquartered in Naju, with Seoul listed in the data. Listed on the Korea Exchange (015760) and NYSE (KEP), with the government as a major shareholder. Well-known domestic utility, but not consumer-choice.

Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) is Kuwait's state-owned oil company, controlling upstream production, refining, petrochemicals, tankers and international marketing through subsidiaries such as Kuwait Oil Company, Kuwait National Petroleum Company and Kuwait Petroleum International, which runs the Q8 brand across Europe. Wholly owned by the government of Kuwait. Customers are refiners, traders and drivers at Q8 stations. Not listed. Q8 is a recognised fuel brand in parts of Europe.

Stegra, formerly H2 Green Steel, is a Stockholm-based company building a large green steel plant in Boden in northern Sweden that uses hydrogen from renewable power to produce near-zero-emission steel. Founded in 2020 by Harald Mix and Carl Hamilton. Customers include automakers such as Mercedes-Benz, Scania, and other manufacturers with offtake agreements. Crunchbase shows about $12.6 billion in funding including debt. Private, with construction ongoing and financing pressure reported in 2025. B2B brand with growing press attention.

Var Energi is the largest independent exploration and production company on the Norwegian continental shelf, producing roughly 250,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day from fields such as Goliat, Balder and Ormen Lange. Headquartered in Sandnes, Rogaland. Owned mainly by Eni and HitecVision, and listed on Oslo Bors (VAR) since 2022. Customers are refiners and gas buyers across Europe. B2B energy producer, with little consumer brand awareness.

AvalonBay Communities is a US real estate investment trust that develops, owns and operates apartment communities in high-cost coastal markets in New England, New York, the mid-Atlantic, the Pacific Northwest and California, with about 300 communities and around 90,000 apartment homes. Revenue comes from rent. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia. Listed on NYSE (AVB). Consumer-facing for renters locally, but not a national consumer brand.

Bank Hapoalim is Israel's largest bank by assets, offering retail, business, corporate and private banking, capital markets and credit cards through branches and digital channels, with operations abroad. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, founded in 1921. Customers are Israeli consumers and businesses. Listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (POLI). Very strong domestic brand, with sports sponsorship in Israel.

Bank Leumi is one of Israel's two largest banks, providing retail, business, private and corporate banking, mortgages, capital markets and its Pepper digital bank, with global operations. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, founded in 1902. Customers are Israeli consumers and businesses. Listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (LUMI). Strong domestic consumer brand.

Chehaoduo is a Beijing-based Chinese online car trading group operating Guazi (used cars) and Maodou (new cars) platforms, connecting buyers and sellers directly and offering financing and services. Customers are Chinese car buyers and dealers. Backed by SoftBank, Hillhouse and others, with large past funding. Crunchbase shows about $3.8 billion in funding. Private. Scaled back its operations in recent years. Familiar in China through heavy advertising.

Coupang is a South Korean e-commerce giant based in Seattle that runs the Coupang marketplace, Rocket Delivery fast shipping, Rocket Wow membership, Coupang Eats food delivery, Coupang Play streaming and Taiwan expansion, with revenue of around $30 billion and tens of millions of customers. Founded in 2010 by Bom Kim. Listed on NYSE (CPNG) since 2021, with SoftBank Vision Fund a major early investor. Dominant Korean consumer brand with heavy advertising.

Digikala is Iran's largest online retailer, selling electronics, fashion, books, home goods and groceries, with a marketplace for third-party sellers and Digipay payments. Headquartered in Tehran, founded in 2006 by brothers Hamid and Saeed Mohammadi. Customers are Iranian consumers. Funding is shown in Iranian rials. Because it operates in Iran, US and EU sanctions exposure makes it unsuitable for most international sponsorship. Very strong consumer brand domestically.

Ecopetrol is Colombia's largest integrated oil and gas company, operating production, refining, pipelines through Cenit, petrochemicals and renewable energy, with ISA transmission networks as a subsidiary and operations in Brazil, Peru and the US Permian Basin. Headquartered in Bogota, with the Colombian government holding about 88 percent. Listed on the Colombian exchange (ECOPETROL) and NYSE (EC). Revenue is around $30 billion. Well-known national brand with a history of sports sponsorship in Colombia.

EQT is a Stockholm-based global investment firm running private equity, infrastructure, real estate, growth and venture funds, with about 270 billion euros in assets under management and portfolio companies across Europe, North America and Asia. Customers are institutional investors such as pension funds and sovereign funds, with revenue from management fees and carried interest. Founded in 1994 with roots in the Wallenberg family's Investor AB. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (EQT) since 2019. Well-known in finance, low consumer awareness.

ESPN is a US sports media network based in Bristol, Connecticut, operating the ESPN family of cable channels, ESPN streaming, ESPN.com and ESPN Radio, with rights to the NFL, NBA, MLB and college sports, and US Formula 1 rights through 2025 before Apple took them over. Revenue comes from carriage fees, advertising and subscriptions. Owned by Disney (about 72 percent) and Hearst (about 18 percent), with the NFL taking a stake in 2025. Not separately listed. Very strong consumer sports brand and a major advertising platform.

Eurobank is one of the four main Greek banks, offering retail, SME, corporate and private banking, plus insurance and asset management, with operations in Greece, Cyprus (it took control of Hellenic Bank in 2024), Bulgaria, Serbia and Luxembourg. Headquartered in Athens. Customers are consumers and businesses. Listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (EUROB). Strong consumer banking brand in Greece.

Fortum is a Finnish clean energy company generating hydro, nuclear, wind and solar power, mainly in the Nordic countries and Poland, and selling electricity and heat to businesses, utilities and consumers, plus recycling and waste services. Headquartered in Espoo. Customers include industrial buyers and electricity wholesalers. Controlled by the Finnish state, which owns about 51 percent. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki (FORTUM). Recognised energy brand in Finland.

Full Truck Alliance (Manbang) runs China's largest digital freight platform, matching shippers with truck drivers through the Yunmanman and Huochebang apps, and offering financing, fuel cards, insurance and other services. Revenue comes from membership fees, commissions and value-added services, with millions of active truck drivers and shippers. Operations are in China, with Crunchbase listing Nanjing. Listed on NYSE (YMM) since 2021. B2B platform brand with strong recognition in Chinese logistics.

Global Payments is a merchant payments technology company headquartered in Atlanta, offering card acceptance, point-of-sale software, issuer processing and commerce tools to millions of businesses and financial institutions worldwide. It merged with TSYS in 2019 and, in 2025, agreed to buy Worldpay while selling its Issuer Solutions business to FIS. Revenue is about $10 billion. Listed on NYSE (GPN). B2B brand, known in banking and retail, with limited consumer awareness.

International Islamic Liquidity Management Corporation (IILM) is a Kuala Lumpur-based multilateral institution that issues short-term Shariah-compliant sukuk, giving Islamic financial institutions a tool to manage liquidity. It was established in 2010 and is owned by central banks and monetary authorities from countries including Malaysia, Kuwait, Turkey, Qatar and the UAE. Customers are Islamic banks and investors. Not listed. Institutional brand with no consumer awareness.

Kuwait Finance House (KFH) is one of the world's largest Islamic banks, offering Shariah-compliant retail, corporate, investment and real estate finance in Kuwait, Bahrain, Turkey, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia and elsewhere. Founded in 1977 and headquartered in Kuwait City, it merged with Ahli United Bank in 2022 and is a pioneer in Islamic banking. Listed on Boursa Kuwait (KFH). Strong consumer brand in Kuwait and the Gulf with significant advertising and sponsorship.

Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) is Kuwait's sovereign wealth fund, set up in 1953, managing the General Reserve Fund and Future Generations Fund with assets estimated at well over 900 billion dollars across global equities, bonds, real estate and private equity. It is wholly owned by the Kuwaiti government and invests overseas. Not listed. An institutional investor with no consumer brand, though it holds stakes in many companies.

LG Energy Solution is a South Korean maker of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, energy storage systems and IT devices, supplying GM, Hyundai, Stellantis, Honda and other carmakers from plants in Korea, the US, Poland, China and Indonesia. Spun out of LG Chem in 2020 and listed on the Korea Exchange (373220) in January 2022, in one of the largest Korean IPOs. Headquartered in Seoul, with annual revenue of about 25 trillion won. B2B supplier, known through the LG brand.

MuniFin (Municipality Finance Plc) is a Finnish credit institution that provides loans and leasing to municipalities, joint municipal authorities, and non-profit housing providers, funded by international bond issues with high credit ratings. Headquartered in Helsinki. Owned by Finnish municipalities, the pension provider Keva and the Finnish state. Revenue comes from interest margins. Not listed on an equity exchange. Public-sector finance brand with no consumer visibility.

Neste is a Finnish refiner and a leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel from waste and residue oils, with refineries in Finland, the Netherlands and Singapore, plus oil products and polymer solutions. Customers are airlines, fuel distributors, transport companies and chemical makers, with revenue of about 20 billion euros. Headquartered in Espoo, with the Finnish state owning about 44 percent. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki (NESTE). Well known in Finland and a long-time rally sponsor, including Rally Finland.

Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) is a Helsinki-based international financial institution owned by Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway and Sweden, lending for projects that improve competitiveness and the environment, such as infrastructure, energy and innovation. It raises money in capital markets with a AAA rating. Customers are companies, public bodies and projects in member countries. Not listed. Institutional brand with no consumer visibility.

Orlen, formerly PKN Orlen, is a Polish multi-energy group that operates refineries and petrochemical plants, produces oil and gas, generates power, and runs about 3,000 fuel stations in Poland, Germany, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary and Lithuania. It merged with Lotos and PGNiG in 2022. Headquartered in Plock, with the Polish state as the largest shareholder. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (PKN). Strong consumer fuel brand in Poland with a history in motorsport, including Robert Kubica and Alfa Romeo Racing Orlen.

PKO Bank Polski (PKO BP) is Poland's largest bank, offering retail, SME, corporate and private banking, mortgages, cards, investment funds and insurance via its large branch network, the IKO mobile app and subsidiaries. Headquartered in Warsaw, founded in 1919 and controlled by the Polish state through the Treasury. Customers are about 11 million Polish clients. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (PKO). Very strong consumer brand in Poland with sports and cultural sponsorship.

PPC Group, formerly Public Power Corporation, is Greece's largest electricity company, generating power from lignite, gas, hydro and growing renewables, and supplying and distributing electricity to millions of customers in Greece, Romania, Bulgaria and other Balkan markets, plus fibre broadband and EV charging. Headquartered in Athens, with the Greek state a major shareholder (about 34 percent). Listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (PPC). Well-known national consumer brand in Greece.

SMBC Aviation Capital is a Dublin-based aircraft leasing company, owning and managing a fleet of about 700 aircraft that it leases to airlines worldwide, with revenue from lease rentals. It is owned by Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Sumitomo Corporation and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. Not listed. Large lessor within the aviation industry, with visibility to airlines but no consumer awareness.

Suning.com is a Chinese retailer of electronics, appliances and general merchandise, operating thousands of physical stores and an online platform, logistics and financial services. Founded in 1990 and based in Nanjing, with revenue in the hundreds of billions of yuan at its peak. It ran into financial trouble in 2021 and was bailed out by a group of Jiangsu state-linked investors. Listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (002024). Its parent group owned Inter Milan until 2024 and has deep sports sponsorship experience. Strong Chinese consumer brand.

Turk Eximbank is Turkey's state-owned export credit agency, giving export credits, guarantees and insurance to Turkish exporters, overseas investors and contractors, with financing for trade and projects abroad. Headquartered in Istanbul, owned by the Turkish Treasury. Customers are Turkish exporters and banks. Funding is raised from international bond markets and bank loans. Not listed. Public-sector finance brand with no consumer visibility.

Weatherford International is an oilfield services company providing drilling, well construction, completions, production and intervention technology, such as managed pressure drilling and artificial lift, in about 75 countries. Customers are national and international oil and gas companies, with revenue of about $5 billion. Legally domiciled in Ireland (Dublin) and operationally headquartered in Houston, Texas. Listed on Nasdaq (WFRD). B2B energy services brand with no consumer awareness.

Xingsheng Youxuan (Xingsheng Selected) is a Changsha, Hunan based community group-buying platform, where residents order groceries and daily goods via mini-programs, with next-day pickup at neighbourhood community stores. Revenue comes from product sales and fees. Reported to be backed by investors including Alibaba. Crunchbase shows about $5.2 billion in total funding. Private. Regional consumer brand within China's community commerce segment.

YPF is Argentina's largest energy company, producing oil and gas, notably from the Vaca Muerta shale formation, refining, selling fuels at its national network of YPF service stations and Elaion lubricants, and operating petrochemicals and power. Headquartered in Buenos Aires, with the Argentine state owning about 51 percent after the 2012 renationalisation. Listed on NYSE (YPF) and BYMA. Very visible consumer fuel brand in Argentina with long ties to national motorsport.

Resilience is a New York-based cyber risk management company that combines cyber insurance with risk assessment and security tools, helping companies measure, manage and insure against cyber threats. Customers are mid-size and large businesses, with revenue from insurance premiums and software. Crunchbase shows about $217 million in total funding. Private. B2B brand known in the cyber and risk community, with little consumer awareness.

AAR Corp is an aerospace and defence services company providing aviation aftermarket support: aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul, parts supply, expeditionary services and fleet management for commercial airlines and the US government. Headquartered in Wood Dale, Illinois, founded in 1951, with revenue of about $2.5 billion. Listed on NYSE (AIR). B2B brand known in aviation, with no consumer awareness.

Aditya Birla Renewables is the renewable energy arm of India's Aditya Birla Group, developing and operating solar and wind power plants and supplying clean electricity to industrial and commercial customers and utilities. Headquartered in Mumbai, with a portfolio of several gigawatts, and a target of over 10 gigawatts. Crunchbase shows about $2.1 billion in funding, including project financing. Part of the privately controlled Aditya Birla Group. B2B energy brand, though the Aditya Birla name is widely known in India.

Altus Power is a Stamford, Connecticut-based provider of commercial-scale solar power and energy storage, owning and operating rooftop and ground-mounted solar for commercial, industrial, public sector and community customers, and selling power under long-term contracts, plus EV charging. Revenue was about $200 million. It listed on NYSE (AMPS) via a 2021 SPAC merger, and agreed in 2025 to be acquired by TPG. B2B clean energy brand with little consumer awareness.

AMEA Power is a Dubai-based renewable energy developer and independent power producer building solar, wind and battery storage projects in Africa and the Middle East, including in Egypt, Morocco, Jordan, Zambia and South Africa. It sells electricity to national utilities and industrial customers under long-term contracts. Founded in 2016 by Hussain Al Nowais. Crunchbase shows about $2.1 billion in funding, including project debt. Privately held. B2B brand, no consumer awareness.

Astranis builds small, dedicated geostationary communications satellites (MicroGEO) that give countries and telecom operators a faster, cheaper route to broadband coverage, with customers including Thaicom, Orbits Corp, Pacific Dataport and Anuvu. Headquartered in San Francisco and founded in 2015. Revenue comes from satellite sales and service. Has raised about $1.7 billion in funding. Private. B2B space brand with a strong profile in the satellite industry and little consumer awareness.

Atlas Energy Solutions produces and delivers proppant (frac sand) and logistics services to oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin of West Texas and New Mexico, using local mines and a last-mile logistics system. Headquartered in Austin, Texas. Customers are exploration and production companies and oilfield service firms. Listed on NYSE (AESI) since its 2023 IPO. B2B, with little consumer brand awareness.

Aureus Capital is a private equity investment company based in New York, New York, according to Crunchbase, classified under finance and financial services. Crunchbase shows about $2 billion in total funding as listed. Its investment focus, portfolio and ownership are not described in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Bahri, the National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia, operates one of the world's largest fleets of very large crude carriers (VLCCs), plus chemical tankers, bulk carriers and roll-on roll-off vessels, and offers logistics services. Headquartered in Riyadh, with the Public Investment Fund the largest shareholder. Customers are oil producers, refiners and chemical shippers, including Saudi Aramco. Listed on Tadawul (4030). Well-known corporate brand in Saudi Arabia and B2B shipping circles.

Banco BPM is Italy's third-largest banking group by assets, offering retail, SME, corporate, private banking, bancassurance and asset management, with roots in northern Italy and a presence from Milan and Verona. Formed in 2017 from the merger of Banco Popolare and Banca Popolare di Milano. Credit Agricole is its largest shareholder. UniCredit made a takeover offer in 2024 and withdrew in 2025. Listed on Borsa Italiana (BAMI). Recognised consumer bank brand in northern Italy.

Banco Bradesco is one of Brazil's largest private banks, offering retail and corporate banking, credit cards, insurance (Bradesco Seguros), asset management and investment banking through more than 3,000 branches and a large digital customer base. Headquartered in Osasco, Sao Paulo, founded in 1943, with total assets of over one trillion reais. Listed on B3 (BBDC4) and NYSE (BBD). Very strong consumer brand in Brazil, with extensive sports and cultural sponsorships.

Base Power is an Austin, Texas startup that sells home battery systems and electricity plans to Texas homeowners, installing batteries at no upfront cost and aggregating them as a distributed power plant for the grid. Founded in 2023 by Zach Dell, Justin Lopas and others. Crunchbase shows about $2.3 billion in total funding after a $1 billion round in 2025. Private. Growing consumer brand in Texas, with a notable founder and investor profile.

BBVA Mexico (formerly BBVA Bancomer) is Mexico's largest bank, offering retail, SME, corporate and investment banking, cards, mortgages, insurance and wealth management, with more than 25 million customers. Headquartered in Mexico City and nearly wholly owned by Spanish group BBVA. Its parent is listed on the Madrid stock exchange. Very strong consumer brand in Mexico, with major sports sponsorships including the Estadio BBVA naming in Monterrey and the long-running Liga BBVA MX title sponsorship.

Beta Technologies builds electric aircraft: the ALIA CX300 conventional takeoff and landing plane and the ALIA VTOL vertical lift aircraft, along with electric propulsion systems and a network of aircraft chargers. Customers include cargo operators such as UPS, Bristow and Air New Zealand, and the US Air Force. Headquartered in South Burlington, Vermont, founded in 2017 by Kyle Clark. Listed on NYSE (BETA) after a 2025 IPO. B2B aerospace brand, known in the eVTOL sector.

BPER Banca is an Italian banking group based in Modena, providing retail, SME, corporate, private banking and bancassurance services through branches mainly in northern and central Italy. It expanded by acquiring Banca Popolare di Sondrio in 2025 after acquiring Intesa branches. Customers are Italian households and businesses. Listed on Borsa Italiana (BPE). Recognised regional consumer bank with local sports and cultural sponsorships.

Brazos Midstream is a Fort Worth, Texas midstream company that gathers and processes natural gas, crude oil and produced water, with assets mainly in the Delaware Basin of West Texas and New Mexico. Customers are oil and gas producers, with fee-based revenue. Crunchbase shows about $1.9 billion in funding, which likely includes private equity and debt. Private. B2B energy infrastructure, with no consumer awareness.

Bread Financial, formerly Alliance Data Systems, is a Columbus, Ohio financial services company offering private-label and co-brand credit cards, buy now pay later, and savings products, working with retail partners such as Ulta Beauty, Wayfair and Signet. Revenue comes from interest and fees on card balances. Listed on NYSE (BFH). B2B2C brand: known in retail partnerships, with the Bread name less known to consumers.

BrightNight is a West Palm Beach, Florida renewable power developer that builds hybrid solar-plus-storage projects and sells clean power to utilities and large customers using its software platform for dispatchable renewable energy. Founded in 2018. Crunchbase shows about $2.4 billion in total funding, including project financing. Private. B2B energy brand with no consumer awareness.

Brookfield Renewable Partners is one of the world's largest publicly traded renewable power platforms, owning hydro, wind, solar and storage assets across North America, South America, Europe and Asia, and selling power to utilities and corporate buyers under long-term contracts. Part of Brookfield Asset Management, with offices in Toronto. Listed on NYSE (BEP) and TSX (BEP.UN). B2B energy brand, known in infrastructure investing with low consumer awareness.

BTG Pactual is Latin America's largest independent investment bank, offering investment banking, asset management, wealth management, trading, research and a retail digital bank, with operations across Brazil, Latin America, the US and Europe. Headquartered in Sao Paulo, founded in 1983, and led by Andre Esteves. Customers are institutions, wealthy individuals and mass-market digital users. Listed on B3 (BPAC11). Strong finance brand in Brazil, with sports sponsorship.

Calumet manufactures and sells specialty petroleum products such as lubricating oils, solvents, waxes and asphalt, and through Montana Renewables produces renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, with refineries in Louisiana, Texas, Montana and Wisconsin. Customers are industrial, consumer product and fuel buyers. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Listed on Nasdaq (CLMT). B2B brand with limited consumer awareness.

Canadian Solar is a global solar and battery storage company that makes solar modules and e-STORAGE battery systems and develops utility-scale solar and storage projects, with manufacturing largely in China, Southeast Asia and the US. Founded in 2001 by Shawn Qu, with Canadian head office in Kitchener, Ontario. Customers are utilities, developers and distributors in dozens of countries. Listed on Nasdaq (CSIQ). B2B energy brand, known in the solar industry.

CBRE Investment Management is a global real assets investment manager, part of CBRE Group, investing in real estate, infrastructure and renewable energy on behalf of pension funds, insurers and sovereign wealth funds, with more than 150 billion dollars of assets under management. Its Toronto office appears in Crunchbase, though the firm is run from Radnor, Pennsylvania. Revenue comes from management fees. The parent CBRE Group is listed on NYSE (CBRE). B2B asset manager with little consumer awareness.

Centrus Energy supplies nuclear fuel and enrichment services, including low enriched uranium (LEU) for nuclear power plants and high-assay LEU (HALEU) for advanced reactors, working with the US Department of Energy at Piketon, Ohio. Headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, and formerly part of USEC. Customers are utilities worldwide, with revenue of about $400 million. Listed on NYSE American (LEU). B2B nuclear fuel brand, notable in the energy sector.

CI Financial is a Toronto-based wealth and asset management company offering mutual funds, advisory and wealth services in Canada, the US and Australia through CI Global Asset Management, Corient and others, with hundreds of billions of dollars under management and administration. Customers are retail investors and advisors, with revenue from management fees. Taken private in 2025 by a Mubadala Capital-led investor group, previously listed on the TSX (CIX). Known among Canadian investors.

Cloud Capital is a global investment management firm based in Washington, DC, according to Crunchbase, which classifies it under angel investment and finance. Crunchbase shows about $1.85 billion in funding as listed, which may be assets raised. Its investment focus, ownership and portfolio are not described in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Cologix is a North American network-neutral data centre and interconnection operator, with facilities in markets such as Columbus, Dallas, Minneapolis, Montreal, Toronto and Vancouver, where enterprises, cloud providers and carriers connect and house equipment. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Revenue comes from colocation, interconnection and cloud connectivity fees. Owned by infrastructure investor Stonepeak. Crunchbase shows about $2.7 billion in funding, mainly financing. Private. B2B infrastructure brand with no consumer awareness.

Columbia Financial is the holding company for Columbia Bank in New Jersey, a community bank offering consumer and commercial banking, mortgages and business loans through more than 60 branches in New Jersey and New York, with assets of roughly $10 billion. Headquartered in Fair Lawn, New Jersey. Listed on Nasdaq (CLBK), with Columbia Bank MHC as majority owner. Regional consumer bank, no national awareness.

Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) is a Doha-based Qatari bank offering conventional retail, corporate and private banking, cards, treasury and investment services, and owns Alternatif Bank in Turkey and has a stake in United Arab Bank of the UAE. Founded in 1975. Customers are Qatari consumers and companies. Listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange (CBQK). Recognisable consumer bank in Qatar with sports and event sponsorship.

Credit Agricole Assurances is the insurance arm of Credit Agricole, one of France's largest insurers, selling life insurance (Predica), property and casualty (Pacifica), creditor insurance and protection products through the Credit Agricole and LCL bank networks and abroad. Based in Paris, with premiums of about 35 billion euros. Wholly owned by Credit Agricole SA and not listed separately. Strong brand in France through its bank parent.

Diversified Energy Company acquires and operates mature, low-decline natural gas and oil wells, mainly in the Appalachian Basin, and has expanded to Oklahoma, Louisiana and Texas, producing about 800 million cubic feet of gas equivalent per day. Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, with its roots in the UK. Listed on NYSE (DEC) and the London Stock Exchange (DEC). B2B energy producer, little consumer brand awareness.

Drax Group is a UK renewable energy company that generates power from biomass at the Drax Power Station in Selby, North Yorkshire, which provides about 5 percent of UK electricity, plus hydro and pumped storage, and produces wood pellets in North America. It also supplies electricity to businesses. Customers are the UK grid, industrial users and businesses. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (DRX). Well-known in UK energy, though also controversial over biomass.

Edify Energy is an Australian renewable energy developer based in Sydney, which develops, finances and operates utility-scale solar farms and battery storage in Australia. Revenue comes from power sales under long-term contracts with utilities and corporate buyers. Crunchbase shows about A$3.4 billion in total funding, mostly project finance. Privately held. B2B energy brand, with no consumer awareness.

Elia is the Belgian electricity transmission system operator, running Belgium's high-voltage grid and, through the Elia Group, also Germany's 50Hertz network, plus consulting and interconnector projects. Customers are electricity producers, suppliers and distributors via regulated tariffs. Headquartered in Brussels, with Belgian local authorities and Publi-T as the main shareholders and a free float. Listed on Euronext Brussels (ELI). Regulated infrastructure with no consumer-facing brand.

Ellington Financial is a specialty finance company that acquires and manages residential mortgage loans, mortgage-backed securities, consumer loans and other credit assets, externally managed by Ellington Management Group. Headquartered in Old Greenwich, Connecticut, and structured as a real estate investment trust. Revenue comes from net interest income and investment gains. Listed on NYSE (EFC). Investor-focused brand with no consumer awareness.

Enbridge Westcoast natural gas pipeline system is the British Columbia natural gas gathering, processing and transmission network operated by Calgary-based pipeline giant Enbridge, in this entry a joint venture or minority stake structure. Customers are gas producers, LNG projects and utilities moving gas through the network, with regulated revenue. Crunchbase shows about C$2.7 billion in funding, possibly a stake sale. Enbridge itself is listed on the TSX and NYSE (ENB). B2B energy infrastructure with no consumer brand awareness.

Encore Capital Group is an international specialty finance company that buys and collects defaulted consumer debt, including credit card receivables, through Midland Credit Management in the US and Cabot Credit Management in the UK. Headquartered in San Diego, California. Revenue comes from collections on purchased portfolios, at around $1.5 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (ECPG). Debt-collection brand with limited public recognition and reputational sensitivity.

EnergyRe is a New York-based clean energy company, according to Crunchbase, which describes it as being at the center of the clean energy future and classifies it under energy. Crunchbase shows about $2.6 billion in total funding as listed, which may include project financing. Its projects, ownership and customers are not described in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

ENGIE Brasil Energia is Brazil's largest private electricity generator, with around 10 gigawatts of capacity from hydro, wind, solar and thermal plants, plus transmission lines and gas distribution, selling power to distributors and large industrial customers. Headquartered in Florianopolis (Crunchbase lists Rio de Janeiro), and controlled by France's ENGIE, which holds about 68 percent. Listed on B3 (EGIE3). Corporate B2B brand with limited consumer visibility.

Equitable Bank, the main subsidiary of EQB Inc., is a Toronto-based Canadian Schedule I bank focused on residential mortgages, commercial lending and its digital EQ Bank, which offers high-interest savings, term deposits and no-fee accounts. Founded in 1970. Customers are Canadian consumers, mortgage borrowers and businesses, with about C$130 billion in assets. Listed on the TSX (EQB). Digital banking brand known to Canadian savers.

ESENTIA Energy Systems is a Mexican private natural gas infrastructure company operating pipelines that transport gas to power plants and industry in Mexico, based in Mexico City. Customers are the state electricity utility CFE and industrial buyers on long-term capacity contracts. Crunchbase shows about $2.3 billion in funding, largely financing. Private. B2B infrastructure brand with no consumer awareness.

Evergy is a Kansas City-based electric utility serving about 1.7 million customers in Kansas and Missouri, generating power from nuclear, coal, natural gas, wind and solar, and delivering it through regulated networks. Formed in 2018 by the merger of Westar Energy and Great Plains Energy. Revenue is around $5.5 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (EVRG). Local utility brand.

Fervo Energy is a geothermal company developing enhanced geothermal systems that use horizontal drilling from oil and gas techniques to produce round-the-clock clean power, with the Cape Station project in Utah and contracts with utilities and technology firms including Google. Founded in 2017 and based in Houston. Crunchbase shows about $1.9 billion in total funding. Private. Strong profile in the clean energy sector, with limited consumer awareness.

Fidra Energy is an Edinburgh, Scotland-based developer of large-scale battery energy storage, with its Thorpe Marsh project in Yorkshire of about 1.4 gigawatts among the largest in Europe. Revenue comes from grid services and energy trading. Crunchbase shows about 1.27 billion in funding, largely project finance. Privately held. B2B energy brand with no consumer awareness.

Form Energy develops iron-air batteries designed to store electricity for around 100 hours at low cost, for utilities and grid operators, with a factory in Weirton, West Virginia, and pilot projects with utilities such as Great River Energy and Xcel Energy. Headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts, and founded in 2017. Crunchbase shows about $2.6 billion in total funding. Private. B2B technology brand known in energy storage, with little consumer awareness.

GE Vernova is a global energy equipment company spun out of General Electric in April 2024, making gas turbines, wind turbines, grid equipment and electrification software, and servicing power plants. Customers are utilities, governments and industrial buyers, with revenue of about $35 billion. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts (listed in Crunchbase as Boston). Listed on NYSE (GEV). B2B brand, known in energy and industry, with moderate consumer awareness through the GE heritage.

Generali Group is one of the world's largest insurers, selling life, property and casualty insurance and asset management in about 50 countries, with premiums of about 95 billion euros. Founded in 1831 in Trieste, with business centres in Trieste and Milan. Customers are individuals and businesses. Listed on Borsa Italiana (G). Strong consumer brand in Italy and across Europe, with a winged lion logo and substantial sponsorships.

Gibson Energy is a Calgary-based Canadian midstream company that stores, gathers, processes and markets crude oil and refined products, with terminals at Hardisty and Edmonton and a stake in the Gateway Terminal in Texas. Customers are producers and refiners. Revenue is mostly fee-based. Listed on the TSX (GEI). B2B energy infrastructure brand with little consumer awareness.

GoodLeap is a technology company based in Roseville, California that provides point-of-sale financing and software for home solar panels, batteries, roofing, HVAC and other home improvement projects, through installers and contractors. Customers are homeowners and installers, with revenue from loan fees and software. Founded in 2017 as Loanpal and rebranded in 2022. Crunchbase shows about $2.2 billion in funding, largely debt. Private. B2B2C brand, known to installers.

Greenbacker Group is a New York-based renewable energy company that develops, owns and manages solar, wind and storage assets, along with an investment management business that runs funds for investors. Revenue comes from power sales, management fees and developer services. Founded in 2013. Crunchbase shows about $2 billion in total funding. Private. B2B energy and finance brand, with no consumer awareness.

Groupama is a French mutual insurance group offering car, home, health, life and professional insurance in France and abroad, including Italy, Spain, Greece, Romania and Turkey, through agents and regional mutuals. Headquartered in Paris, with revenue of about 17 billion euros. Customers are consumers, farmers and businesses. A mutual, not listed. Well-known French consumer brand and an active sports sponsor, naming the Groupama Stadium in Lyon and the Groupama-FDJ cycling team.

Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR) operates nine airports in southeastern Mexico including Cancun, the busiest, plus Merida, Cozumel and Villahermosa, and airports in Puerto Rico (San Juan) and Colombia (Rionegro). Revenue comes from airport charges, retail and advertising, with about 50 million passengers a year. Listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange (ASUR) and NYSE (ASR), with Grupo ADO a key shareholder. Notable advertising and partnership inventory through tourism traffic.

Guotai Junan Securities was a major Chinese brokerage and investment bank offering securities trading, wealth management, investment banking, asset management and research, with a large retail customer base in China. Headquartered in Shanghai. In 2025 it merged with Haitong Securities to form Guotai Haitong Securities. Listed on the Shanghai and Hong Kong exchanges. Well-known financial brand in China, with little overseas consumer awareness.

Hadrian builds AI-powered automated factories that make precision parts for aerospace and defence companies, aiming to speed production and cut cost for customers and the US government. Headquartered in Los Angeles area, with a large factory in Arizona. Founded in 2023 by Chris Power. Crunchbase shows about $2.3 billion in funding as listed. Private. B2B industrial technology brand, known in defence-tech investing.

HighPeak Energy is a Fort Worth, Texas independent oil and gas producer focused on the Midland Basin in West Texas, producing about 50,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Founded in 2019 and led by Jack Hightower. Customers are refiners and midstream buyers. Listed on Nasdaq (HPK). B2B energy producer, small to mid-cap, with no consumer brand awareness.

Howard Energy Partners is a San Antonio, Texas midstream company that gathers, processes and transports natural gas and crude oil in South Texas (Eagle Ford) and the Delaware Basin, and has pipeline interests in Mexico. Customers are oil and gas producers and utilities. Crunchbase shows about $2 billion in funding. Private, with private equity ownership. B2B energy infrastructure brand, no consumer awareness.

Howmet Aerospace makes engineered products for aircraft and industrial gas turbines: jet engine airfoils and components, fasteners, forged wheels and structures, supplying Boeing, Airbus, GE Aerospace, RTX and Safran. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, with revenue of around $7 billion. Formed in 2020 when Arconic split into Howmet and Arconic Corporation. Listed on NYSE (HWM). B2B aerospace supplier with no consumer awareness.

Hybar is a steel producer that builds and operates a scrap metal recycling steel mill in Osceola, Arkansas, producing rebar and other long steel products from recycled metal. Customers are construction and infrastructure contractors. Crunchbase shows about $1.8 billion in funding, large for a single mill and probably reflecting a major project investment. Private. B2B industrial brand with little consumer awareness.

Hydrostor develops advanced compressed air energy storage that stores power as compressed air in underground caverns, giving utilities long-duration storage of eight hours or more, with projects such as Willow Rock in California and Silver City in Australia. Headquartered in Toronto, founded in 2010. Customers are utilities and grid operators. Crunchbase shows about $2.4 billion in total funding including project financing. Private. B2B clean tech brand with no consumer awareness.

iA Financial Group, formerly Industrial Alliance, is a Quebec City-based Canadian insurance and wealth management company selling life and health insurance, group benefits, auto and home insurance, retirement savings and investment funds, plus US dealer services and auto insurance. Customers are Canadian individuals and employers, with an expanding presence in the US. Founded in 1892. Listed on the TSX (IAG). Strong brand in Quebec, with sports and community sponsorship.

IDFC FIRST Bank is an Indian private-sector bank formed in 2018 by the merger of IDFC Bank and Capital First, offering retail banking, credit cards, vehicle and home loans, microfinance and corporate banking to millions of customers through branches and digital channels. Headquartered in Mumbai. Listed on the NSE and BSE (IDFCFIRSTB). Recognised consumer bank in India with active marketing.

iFood is Brazil's largest food delivery platform, connecting consumers with restaurants, supermarkets and pharmacies via its app, with its own delivery fleet and payment services. Based in Osasco, Sao Paulo, it was founded in 2011, and is controlled by Prosus after buying out Just Eat Takeaway's stake in 2022. Revenue comes from commissions, delivery fees and advertising. Very strong consumer brand in Brazil with heavy marketing and sports partnerships.

IIFL Finance is a Mumbai-based Indian non-banking finance company offering gold loans, home loans, business loans and microfinance, through about 4,000 branches across India. Customers are retail borrowers and small businesses, with revenue from interest. It spun off from the IIFL group in 2019 and, in 2024, faced a temporary regulatory restriction on gold loans. Listed on the NSE and BSE (IIFL). Recognised consumer finance brand in India.

Juniper Green Energy is a Gurugram-based Indian renewable energy developer and independent power producer, building and operating wind, solar and hybrid projects and green hydrogen plans, selling power to utilities and industrial buyers. Crunchbase shows about $1.77 billion in funding, including project debt. Private. B2B energy brand with no consumer awareness.

Jupiter Power is an Austin, Texas independent power producer that builds and operates standalone battery energy storage projects, mainly in ERCOT and California, selling grid services and energy to markets and utilities. Backed by BlackRock since 2022. Crunchbase shows about $2.4 billion in total funding, including project financing. Private. B2B energy brand, known in the battery storage industry.

Karman Space & Defense makes mission-critical subsystems and components for missiles, space launch, hypersonics and defence platforms, supplying the US Department of Defense and prime contractors such as Lockheed Martin, RTX and Northrop Grumman. Headquartered in Huntington Beach, California. Listed on NYSE (KRMN) since its February 2025 IPO, with TCI Fund Management a major shareholder. B2B defence supplier, with no consumer awareness.

Kiavi, formerly LendingHome, is a tech-enabled lender providing short-term fix and flip loans and rental loans to residential real estate investors across the US, using an online platform for underwriting. Revenue comes from interest and fees. Headquartered in San Francisco, though Crunchbase lists Pittsburgh. Crunchbase shows about $1.85 billion in funding, mostly debt facilities. Private. B2B brand known among real estate investors.

Kinder Morgan is one of the largest US energy infrastructure companies, operating about 80,000 miles of natural gas, refined products and CO2 pipelines, plus terminals and storage that move around 40 percent of US natural gas. Customers are producers, utilities and LNG exporters, with revenue of about $15 billion. Headquartered in Houston, Texas. Listed on NYSE (KMI). B2B brand, known in energy and investing, with no consumer awareness.

Kosmos Energy is a Dallas-based independent oil and gas exploration and production company focused on offshore West Africa (Ghana, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania and Senegal) and the US Gulf of America, with the Jubilee and Tortue LNG projects. Customers are oil traders and gas buyers. Founded in 2003, with Warburg Pincus and Blackstone as early backers. Listed on NYSE (KOS). B2B energy producer, no consumer awareness.

Kratos Defense & Security Solutions develops unmanned aerial systems such as the Valkyrie and target drones, hypersonic test systems, satellite ground systems, microwave electronics and cyber and training solutions for the US Department of Defense and allied governments. Headquartered in San Diego, California, with revenue of about $1.1 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (KTOS). B2B defence brand, with no consumer awareness and a sensitive category for sponsorship.

Lyntia Networks is a Spanish neutral wholesale fibre-optic and telecom infrastructure operator based in Alcobendas, Madrid, offering dark fibre, backhaul and connectivity services to telecom operators. Customers are carriers and large network users. Crunchbase shows about $1.8 billion in funding, including infrastructure investor capital and debt. Private. B2B infrastructure brand, with no consumer awareness.

Mach Resources, now Mach Natural Resources, is an Oklahoma City-based oil and natural gas company focused on the Anadarko Basin and other mid-continent areas, with non-operated and operated assets. Revenue comes from oil and gas sales. It listed on NYSE (MNR) in 2023 as a limited partnership. Crunchbase shows about $2 billion in funding as listed. B2B energy producer, no consumer awareness.

Magnolia Oil & Gas is a Houston-based exploration and production company focused on the Eagle Ford and Austin Chalk formations of South Texas, producing around 90,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. Formed in 2018 through a SPAC combination with TPG Pace Energy. Customers are refiners and gas buyers. Listed on NYSE (MGY). B2B energy producer, no consumer awareness.

MAPFRE is a Spanish multinational insurer selling life, auto, home, health and commercial insurance in more than 40 countries, with strong positions in Spain, Brazil, Mexico and the US, and reinsurance through MAPFRE RE. Headquartered in Majadahonda, near Madrid, with revenue of about 30 billion euros. Controlled by Fundacion MAPFRE. Listed on the Madrid Stock Exchange (MAP). Strong consumer brand in Spain and Latin America, with sports and cultural sponsorship.

MarineMax is the largest recreational boat and yacht retailer in the US, selling new and used boats and yachts from brands such as Sea Ray, Boston Whaler, Azimut and Grady-White, plus services, marinas, financing and the IGY superyacht marinas. Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, with about 200 locations. Customers are boaters and yacht buyers. Listed on NYSE (HZO). Well-known among boaters, and a premium lifestyle brand that fits some sponsorship.

MDA Space is a Canadian space technology company best known for building the Canadarm robotic arms used on the Space Shuttle and International Space Station, and now making satellites, antennae, robotics and Earth observation systems, including constellations for Telesat and Globalstar. Headquartered in Brampton, Ontario. Customers include governments and satellite operators. Listed on the TSX (MDA) since 2021. B2B brand, notable in the space sector.

Meja Urja Nigam is a coal-fired thermal power plant company in Uttar Pradesh, with a Meja station of about 1,320 megawatts near Prayagraj (Allahabad), a joint venture between NTPC and Uttar Pradesh Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam. It sells electricity to state distribution companies. Crunchbase lists Noida and shows a large funding figure in rupees. State-linked project company. B2B utility with no consumer brand awareness.

MET Group is a Swiss-based international energy company, based in Baar, trading and supplying natural gas and electricity and developing renewable energy, with customers across Europe, particularly in Central and Southeast Europe. Revenue comes from energy trading, supply to industrial and commercial customers and generation. It is privately held. Crunchbase shows about 2.35 billion in funding, as listed. B2B energy brand with little consumer awareness.

Montana Renewables is a Great Falls, Montana facility and company that makes renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel from vegetable oils, fats and greases, and is majority owned by Calumet. It received a US Department of Energy loan guarantee of over $1.4 billion to expand production. Customers are fuel marketers and airlines. Calumet is listed on Nasdaq (CLMT). B2B fuel producer with no consumer awareness.

National Bank of Canada is Canada's sixth-largest bank, offering personal and commercial banking, wealth management, and capital markets, with a strong base in Quebec and a financial markets business that includes Credigy in the US and ABA Bank in Cambodia. Headquartered in Montreal, founded in 1859. Listed on the TSX (NA). Strong consumer brand in Quebec and sponsor of the National Bank Open tennis tournament.

NatWest Group is a major UK banking group, owning NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland and Coutts, serving retail, business and private banking customers across Great Britain. Headquartered in Edinburgh, with London operations. The UK government became the largest shareholder after the 2008 bailout and has since sold down its stake. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (NWG) and NYSE. Very strong UK consumer brand, with a record of major sports sponsorships.

The New Development Bank (NDB) is a multilateral development bank founded by the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa) in 2014 and headquartered in Shanghai, financing infrastructure and sustainable development projects in emerging economies, with new members including Bangladesh, the UAE and Egypt. Its president is Dilma Rousseff. Funded by member capital and bond issuance. Not listed. Institutional brand with no consumer visibility.

Nexfibre is a UK fibre-to-the-home broadband infrastructure company, a joint venture of Liberty Global, Telefonica and the infrastructure investor InfraVia, that builds and operates a full-fibre network for Virgin Media O2, and is rolling out to millions of premises. Based in London. Revenue comes from wholesale access to Virgin Media O2. Crunchbase shows about 1.65 billion in funding. Private. Wholesale infrastructure brand, with no direct consumer recognition.

NGL Energy Partners is a Tulsa, Oklahoma midstream master limited partnership focused on water solutions, handling produced water disposal and recycling in the Permian Basin, plus crude oil logistics and liquids businesses. Customers are oil and gas producers and refiners. Listed on NYSE (NGL). B2B energy infrastructure brand with no consumer awareness.

Nippon Life Insurance Company is Japan's largest private life insurer, a policyholder-owned mutual company headquartered in Osaka, selling life, annuity and health insurance, with major overseas investments including a stake in Resolution Life, which it acquired in 2025, and asset management through Nissay Asset Management. Customers are Japanese consumers and companies, with assets of well over 80 trillion yen. Not listed. Very well-known Japanese consumer insurance brand.

Noor Energy 1 is the Dubai-based owner of the 950-megawatt Noor Energy 1 concentrated solar power and photovoltaic project at the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, which pairs a solar tower and parabolic trough with 15 hours of thermal storage. Shareholders are DEWA (51 percent), ACWA Power (24 percent) and the Silk Road Fund (25 percent). Revenue comes from a long-term power purchase agreement with DEWA. Project financed. B2B project company with no consumer awareness.

Northern Oil and Gas is a Minnetonka, Minnesota company that acquires non-operated minority interests in oil and natural gas wells, mainly in the Williston, Permian, Appalachian and Uinta basins, partnering with operators rather than drilling itself. Revenue comes from its share of production, at about $2 billion. Listed on NYSE American (NOG). Investor-focused brand with no consumer awareness.

NRW.BANK is the development bank of the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, based in Dusseldorf and Munster, providing promotional loans for housing, businesses, startups, municipalities and infrastructure, and funding itself with state-guaranteed bonds. Owned by the state of North Rhine-Westphalia and the regional association Landschaftsverband. Customers are businesses, municipalities and housing investors. Not listed. Public-sector finance brand with regional recognition in Germany.
